701.g: ਸਰਕਿ ਸੇਲ ਸੂਰਮਾ ਮਟਿਕ ਬਾਜ ਸੁਟਿ ਹੈ ॥
701.t: sarak sel sooramaa maTik baaj suT hai ||

701.g: ਅਮੰਡ ਮੰਡਲੀਕ ਸੇ ਅਫੁਟ ਸੂਰ ਫੁਟਿ ਹੈ ॥
701.t: ama(n)dd ma(n)ddaleek se afuT soor fuT hai ||
701.e: Riding enthusiastically on horses, the warriors will throw the pike immediately and will chop down the infinitely glorious warriors

701.g: ਸੁ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਨਾਮ ਸੂਰ ਕੋ ਬਿਸੇਖ ਭੂਪ ਜਾਨੀਐ ॥
701.t: s prem naam soor ko bisekh bhoop jaaneeaai ||

701.g: ਸੁ ਸਾਖ ਤਾਸ ਕੀ ਸਦਾ ਤਿਹੂੰਨ ਲੋਕ ਮਾਨੀਐ ॥੨੫੩॥
701.t: s saakh taas kee sadhaa tihoo(n)n lok maaneeaai ||253||
701.e: O king! the warriors named Prem (love) is a significant fighter, whose greatness is known in all the there worlds.26.253.

701.g: ਅਨੂਪ ਰੂਪ ਭਾਨ ਸੋ ਅਭੂਤ ਰੂਪ ਮਾਨੀਐ ॥
701.t: anoop roop bhaan so abhoot roop maaneeaai ||

701.g: ਸੰਜੋਗ ਨਾਮ ਸਤ੍ਰੁਹਾ ਸੁ ਬੀਰ ਤਾਸੁ ਜਾਨੀਐ ॥
701.t: sa(n)jog naam satruhaa su beer taas jaaneeaai ||
701.e: This warrior of sun-like unique beauty, the killer of enemies, is known by the name of Sanjog (coherence)

701.g: ਸੁ ਸਾਤਿ ਨਾਮ ਸੂਰਮਾ ਸੁ ਅਉਰ ਏਕ ਬੋਲੀਐ ॥
701.t: s saat naam sooramaa su aaur ek boleeaai ||

701.g: ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪ ਜਾਸ ਕੋ ਸਦਾ ਸੁ ਸਰਬ ਲੋਗ ਤੋਲੀਐ ॥੨੫੪॥
701.t: prataap jaas ko sadhaa su sarab log toleeaai ||254||
701.e: There is also another warriors named Shaani (peace), whom all the people recognize as glorious and powerful.27.254.

701.g: ਅਖੰਡ ਮੰਡਲੀਕ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਚੰਡ ਰੂਪ ਦੇਖੀਐ ॥
701.t: akha(n)dd ma(n)ddaleek so pracha(n)dd roop dhekheeaai ||

701.g: ਸੁ ਕੋਪ ਸੁਧ ਸਿੰਘ ਕੀ ਸਮਾਨ ਸੂਰ ਪੇਖੀਐ ॥
701.t: s kop sudh si(n)gh kee samaan soor pekheeaai ||
701.e: This warrior of indivisible and powerful beauty looks highly infuriated like a lion

701.g: ਸੁ ਪਾਠ ਨਾਮ ਤਾਸ ਕੋ ਅਠਾਟ ਤਾਸੁ ਭਾਖੀਐ ॥
701.t: s paaTh naam taas ko aThaaT taas bhaakheeaai ||
701.e: His name is Supaath (good religious study)

701.g: ਭਜ੍ਯੋ ਨ ਜੁਧ ਤੇ ਕਹੂੰ ਨਿਸੇਸ ਸੂਰ ਸਾਖੀਐ ॥੨੫੫॥
701.t: bhajayo na judh te kahoo(n) nises soor saakheeaai ||255||
701.e: Both Surya and Chandra are a witness to it hat he never runs away from war.28.255.

701.g: ਸੁਕਰਮ ਨਾਮ ਏਕ ਕੋ ਸੁਸਿਛ ਦੂਜ ਜਾਨੀਐ ॥
701.t: sukaram naam ek ko susichh dhooj jaaneeaai ||

701.g: ਅਭਿਜ ਮੰਡਲੀਕ ਸੋ ਅਛਿਜ ਤੇਜ ਮਾਨੀਐ ॥
701.t: abhij ma(n)ddaleek so achhij tej maaneeaai ||
701.e: He has one disciple, who is known by the name Sukran (good action) and is considered a warrior of indestructible brilliance in the whole universe

701.g: ਸੁ ਕੋਪ ਸੂਰ ਸਿੰਘ ਜ੍ਯੋਂ ਘਟਾ ਸਮਾਨ ਜੁਟਿ ਹੈ ॥
701.t: s kop soor si(n)gh jayo(n) ghaTaa samaan juT hai ||

701.g: ਦੁਰੰਤ ਬਾਜ ਬਾਜਿ ਹੈ ਅਨੰਤ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਛੁਟਿ ਹੈ ॥੨੫੬॥
701.t: dhura(n)t baaj baaj hai ana(n)t sasatr chhuT hai ||256||
701.e: When that warrior in his fury, thundering like the lion and clouds, will fall upon the enemy, then the dreadful musical instruments will be played and many weapons will strike the blows.29.256.

701.g: ਸੁ ਜਗਿ ਨਾਮ ਏਕ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਬੋਧ ਅਉਰ ਮਾਨੀਐ ॥
701.t: s jag naam ek ko prabodh aaur maaneeaai ||

701.g: ਸੁ ਦਾਨ ਤੀਸਰਾ ਹਠੀ ਅਖੰਡ ਤਾਸੁ ਜਾਨੀਐ ॥
701.t: s dhaan teesaraa haThee akha(n)dd taas jaaneeaai ||
701.e: There is another warriors Suyang (good Yajna), the second is Prabodh (knowledge) and the third warrior is Daan (Charity), who is indivisible persistent

701.g: ਸੁ ਨੇਮ ਨਾਮ ਅਉਰ ਹੈ ਅਖੰਡ ਤਾਸੁ ਭਾਖੀਐ ॥
701.t: s nem naam aaur hai akha(n)dd taas bhaakheeaai ||
701.e: There is another warrior named Suniyam (good principle), who has conquered the whole world

701.g: ਜਗਤ ਜਾਸੁ ਜੀਤਿਆ ਜਹਾਨ ਭਾਨੁ ਸਾਖੀਐ ॥੨੫੭॥
701.t: jagat jaas jeetiaa jahaan bhaan saakheeaai ||257||
701.e: The whole universe and the sun are its witnesses.30.257.

701.g: ਸੁ ਸਤੁ ਨਾਮ ਏਕ ਕੋ ਸੰਤੋਖ ਅਉਰ ਬੋਲੀਐ ॥
701.t: s sat naam ek ko sa(n)tokh aaur boleeaai ||
701.e: There is another warrior Susatya (truth) and another one is Santokh (contentment)

701.g: ਸੁ ਤਪੁ ਨਾਮ ਤੀਸਰੋ ਦਸੰਤ੍ਰ ਜਾਸੁ ਛੋਲੀਐ ॥
701.t: s tap naam teesaro dhasa(n)tr jaas chholeeaai ||
701.e: The third one is Tapsaya (austerity), who has subjugated all the ten directions

701.g: ਸੁ ਜਾਪੁ ਨਾਮ ਏਕ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪ ਆਜ ਤਾਸ ਕੋ ॥
701.t: s jaap naam ek ko prataap aaj taas ko ||
701.e: Another glorious warrior is Japa (repetition of the name).,

701.g: ਅਨੇਕ ਜੁਧ ਜੀਤਿ ਕੈ ਬਰਿਯੋ ਜਿਨੈ ਨਿਰਾਸ ਕੋ ॥੨੫੮॥
701.t: anek judh jeet kai bariyo jinai niraas ko ||258||
701.e: Who after conquering many wars has assumed detachment.31.258.

701.g: ਛਪੈ ਛੰਦ ॥
701.t: chhapai chha(n)dh ||
701.e: CHHAPAI STANZA

701.g: ਅਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਚੰਡ ਬਲਵੰਡ ਨੇਮ ਨਾਮਾ ਇਕ ਅਤਿ ਭਟ ॥
701.t: at pracha(n)dd balava(n)dd nem naamaa ik at bhaT ||

701.g: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਨਾਮ ਦੂਸਰੋ ਸੂਰ ਬੀਰਾਰਿ ਰਣੋਤਕਟ ॥
701.t: prem naam dhoosaro soor beeraar ranotakaT ||
701.e: An extremely powerful and potent warrior is named Niyam (principle) the second warrior is Prem (love),

701.g: ਸੰਜਮ ਏਕ ਬਲਿਸਟਿ ਧੀਰ ਨਾਮਾ ਚਤੁਰਥ ਗਨਿ ॥
701.t: sa(n)jam ek balisaT dheer naamaa chaturath gan ||
701.e: Third one is Snjam (restraint) and the fourth one is Dhairya (patience)

701.g: ਪ੍ਰਾਣਯਾਮ ਪੰਚਵੋ ਧਿਆਨ ਨਾਮਾ ਖਸਟਮ ਭਨਿ ॥
701.t: praanayaam pa(n)chavo dhiaan naamaa khasaTam bhan ||
701.e: And the sixth one is Panayama (regulation of breath) and the sixth one is called Dhyan (meditation)

701.g: ਜੋਧਾ ਅਪਾਰ ਅਨਖੰਡ ਸਤਿ ਅਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪ ਤਿਹ ਮਾਨੀਐ ॥
701.t: jodhaa apaar anakha(n)dd sat at prataap teh maaneeaai ||
701.e: This great warriors is considered extremely truthful and gloruiou,

701.g: ਸੁਰ ਅਸੁਰ ਨਾਗ ਗੰਧ੍ਰਬ ਧਰਮ ਨਾਮ ਜਵਨ ਕੋ ਜਾਨੀਐ ॥੨੫੯॥
701.t: sur asur naag ga(n)dhrab dharam naam javan ko jaaneeaai ||259||
701.e: He is also known by the name Dharma (duty) by the gods, demons, Nagas, and Gandharvas.32.259.

701.g: ਸੁਭਾਚਾਰ ਜਿਹ ਨਾਮ ਸਬਲ ਦੂਸਰ ਅਨੁਮਾਨੋ ॥
701.t: subhaachaar jeh naam sabal dhoosar anumaano ||
701.e: Shubh Acharan (good character) is considered the second warrior

701.g: ਬਿਕ੍ਰਮ ਤੀਸਰੋ ਸੁਭਟ ਬੁਧਿ ਚਤੁਰਥ ਜੀਅ ਜਾਨੋ ॥
701.t: bikram teesaro subhaT budh chaturath jeea jaano ||
701.e: The third warrior is Vikram (Bravery) and the fourth one is mighty Buddh (intellect)

701.g: ਪੰਚਮ ਅਨੁਰਕਤਤਾ ਛਠਮ ਸਾਮਾਧ ਅਭੈ ਭਟ ॥
701.t: pa(n)cham anurakatataa chhaTham saamaadh abhai bhaT ||
701.e: The fifth one is Anuraktata (attachment) and the sixth warrior is Samadhi (contemplaton)

701.g: ਉਦਮ ਅਰੁ ਉਪਕਾਰ ਅਮਿਟ ਅਨਜੀਤ ਅਨਾਕਟ ॥
701.t: audham ar upakaar amiT anajeet anaakaT ||
701.e: Uddam (effort), Upakaar (benevolence) etc. are also unconquerable, invincible and ineffaceable

701.g: ਜਿਹ ਨਿਰਖਿ ਸਤ੍ਰੁ ਤਜਿ ਆਸਨਨਿ ਬਿਮਨ ਚਿਤ ਭਾਜਤ ਤਵਨ ॥
701.t: jeh nirakh satr taj aasanan biman chit bhaajat tavan ||
701.e: Seeing them, the enemies forsake their seat and run away, while deviating from their position

701.g: ਬਲਿ ਟਾਰਿ ਹਾਰਿ ਆਹਵ ਹਠੀ ਅਠਟ ਠਾਟ ਭੁਲਤ ਗਵਨ ॥੨੬੦॥
701.t: bal Taar haar aahav haThee aThaT ThaaT bhulat gavan ||260||
701.e: The glory of these mighty warrior is spread all over the earth.33.260.

701.g: ਤੋਮਰ ਛੰਦ ॥
701.t: tomar chha(n)dh ||
701.e: TOMAR STANZA

701.g: ਸੁ ਬਿਚਾਰ ਹੈ ਭਟ ਏਕ ॥
701.t: s bichaar hai bhaT ek ||

701.g: ਗੁਨ ਬੀਚ ਜਾਸੁ ਅਨੇਕ ॥
701.t: gun beech jaas anek ||
701.e: There is a warrior named Suvichar (good thought), who has many qualities

701.g: ਸੰਜੋਗ ਹੈ ਇਕ ਅਉਰ ॥
701.t: sa(n)jog hai ik aaur ||

701.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਜੀਤਿਆ ਪਤਿ ਗਉਰ ॥੨੬੧॥
701.t: jin jeetiaa pat gaur ||261||
701.e: There is another warriors named Sanjog (coherence), who had even conquered Shiva.34.261.

701.g: ਇਕ ਹੋਮ ਨਾਮ ਸੁ ਬੀਰ ॥
701.t: eik hom naam su beer ||

701.g: ਅਰਿ ਕੀਨ ਜਾਸੁ ਅਧੀਰ ॥
701.t: ar keen jaas adheer ||
701.e: There is one warrior named Hom (sacrifice), who has made the enemies impatient

701.g: ਪੂਜਾ ਸੁ ਅਉਰ ਬਖਾਨ ॥
701.t: poojaa su aaur bakhaan ||

701.g: ਜਿਹ ਸੋ ਨ ਪਉਰਖੁ ਆਨਿ ॥੨੬੨॥
701.t: jeh so na paurakh aan ||262||
701.e: Another one is Pooja (worship), who is unequalled in courage by anyone.35.262.

701.g: ਅਨੁਰਕਤਤਾ ਇਕ ਅਉਰ ॥
701.t: anurakatataa ik aaur ||

701.g: ਸਭ ਸੁਭਟ ਕੋ ਸਿਰ ਮਉਰ ॥
701.t: sabh subhaT ko sir maur ||
701.e: The chief of all the warriors is Anuraktita

702.e: In the same way, there is none like Virakt (unattached).36.263.
Seeing Satsang (good company) and Bal (power), the enthusiasm for fighting is increased and
In the same way, the warrior named Saneh (love) is terribly powerful.37.264.
There are also Har-Bhakti (devotion with the Lord) and Preet (love) with whose light, the whole world is enlightened
The path of Yoga of Dutt is also superb and is considered superior at all the places.38.265.
Seeing the war, Krodh (anger) and Prabodh (knowledge), in their fury, souding their trumpets, marched for attack after decorating their forces.39.266.
DOHRA

702.g: ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਸੈਨ ਬਨਾਇ ਕੈ ਚੜੇ ਨਿਸਾਨ ਬਜਾਇ ॥
702.t: eeh bidh sain banai kai chaRe nisaan bajai ||
702.e: In this way, arranging their forces and sounding their trumpets, the attack was made

702.g: ਜਿਹ ਜਿਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਆਹਵ ਮਚ੍ਯੋ ਸੋ ਸੋ ਕਹਤ ਸੁਨਾਇ ॥੨੬੭॥
702.t: jeh jeh bidh aahav machayo so so kahat sunai ||267||
702.e: The way, in which the war was fought, it presents its description.40.267.
SHRI BHAGVATI STANZA
The arms arose, the warriors fought
The trumpets and other musical instruments were played.41.268.
The lances with tassels were lustrous like fire-flames
The warriors taking them began to fight with one another and there was lamentation.42.269.
The elephants trumpetted, the musical instruments were played
The warriors fought and the armours werr torn.43.270.
The tabors were played  the Bhairavas wandered in the battlefield
And the warriors saturated with blood fell in the fighting.44.271.
Decorated with arms and weapons,
The warriors like Chamuda came to the war-arena.45.272.
The warriors were decorated and the trumpets were sounded
The fighters were enraged like fire and they were not even slightly in senses.46.273.
The warriors were pleased in the war like the fish in water
They were striking blows with their arms and weapons, desirous of getting victorious.47.274.
The bows are infuriated

703.e: The warriors are looking splendid and they are destroying the army.48.275.
The goddess Kali is laughing, the Bhairavas are thundering and holding their vassels in the hands,
The Yoginis have gathered together for drinking blood.49.276.
The goddess is resplendent and the goddess Kali is shouting,
The Bhairvas are thundering and are sounding their tabors.50.277.
There is shower of weapons and the dreadful arms are crackling
The arms of the demons are being discharged from one side and the arms of gods are being used form the other side.51.278.
The Shailastras, Pavanastras and Meghastras are being showered and the fire-arms are crackling.52.279.
The Hansastras, Kakastras and Meghastras are being showered and the Shukarastras are crackling.53.280.
The warriors are bedecked, the Vyomastras are thundering the Yakshastras are being discharged and the Kinnarastras are getting exhausted.54.281.
The Gandharvastras are being discharged and the Narastras are also being used
The eyes of all the warriors are restless and all are uttering,”I”.55.282.
The warriors saturated with blood have fallen in the war-arena and with the sounds of arms weapons, the warriors are also thundering.56.283.
The groups of the red-eyed heavenly damsels are roaming in the sky for the warriors.57.284.
The horses in flocks are roaming hither and thither and the warriors in their anger, are segmenting them.58.285.
The meditation of the great Sannyasi Shiva has been broken and even he is listening to the thundering of Gandharvas and the playing of the musical instruments.59.286.
The voice of the shower of Papastras (the sinful arms) and the crackling of Dharmastras (the arms of Dharma) is being heard
Arogastras (the health arms) and Bhogastras (the pleasure arms) are also being discharged.60.287.
Vivadastras (arms of dispute) and Virodhastras (arms of opposition),
Kumantrastra (arms of bad spells and Sumantrastras (arms of auspicious spells were shot and then burst.61.288.
Kamastras (arms of lust), Karodhastras (the arms of anger) and Virodhastras (arms of opposition) were shwered and Vimohastras (arms of detachment) crackled.62.289.
Charitrastras (arms of conduct) were shot, the Mogastrass (the arms of attachment) collided,
The Trasastras (the arms of fear) rained and Krodhastras (arms of anger) crackled.63.290.
CHAUPAI STANZA

703.g: ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਅਸਤ੍ਰ ਬਹੁ ਛੋਰੇ ॥
703.t: eeh bidh sasatr asatr bahu chhore ||

703.e: In this way, many warriors of king Vivek were given a jerk and they left their arms and weapons
Then the king himself moved and many types of musical instruments were played.64.291.
The trumpets sounded form both the sides and there were thundering noises
The rain of arrows spread on the whole sky and the ghosts and fiends also got entangled.65.292.

703.g: ਝਿਮਿ ਝਿਮਿ ਸਾਰੁ ਗਗਨ ਤੇ ਬਰਖਾ ॥
703.t: jhim jhim saar gagan te barakhaa ||

704.e: There was steady rain of iron from the sky and there was testing of the great warriors alongwith it
The innumerable warriors gathered together and got contracted   there was dreadful mist on all the four sides.66.293.
The king Vivek, getting enraged gave orders to his whole army  all those warriors who arrayed themselves in an army
All those warriors who arrayed themselves in an army rushed forward, the poet now tells their names.67.294.
The warriors wearing helmets on their heads and armour is on their bodies and

704.g: ਚਲੇ ਜੁਧ ਕੇ ਕਾਜ ਸੁ ਬੀਰਾ ॥
704.t: chale judh ke kaaj su beeraa ||

704.e: Bedecked with various kinds of arms and weapons, marched for fighting  the water of the streams dried up in fear.68.295.
DOHRA

704.g: ਦੁਹੂ ਦਿਸਨ ਮਾਰੂ ਬਜ੍ਯੋ ਪਰ੍ਯੋ ਨਿਸਾਣੇ ਘਾਉ ॥
704.t: dhuhoo dhisan maaroo bajayo parayo nisaane ghaau ||
704.e: The deadly musical instruments were played form both the directions and the trumpets thundered

704.g: ਉਮਡਿ ਦੁਬਹੀਆ ਉਠਿ ਚਲੇ ਭਯੋ ਭਿਰਨ ਕੋ ਚਾਉ ॥੨੯੬॥
704.t: aumadd dhubaheeaa uTh chale bhayo bhiran ko chaau ||296||
704.e: The warriors fighting on the strength of both their arms, rushed forward with the zeal for fighting in their mind.69.296.
BHUJANG PRAYAAT STANZA

704.g: ਤਹਾ ਤੂਰ ਭੇਰੀ ਮਹਾ ਸੰਖ ਬਾਜੇ ॥
704.t: tahaa toor bheree mahaa sa(n)kh baaje ||
704.e: The warriors thundering in the battlefield and the kettledrums and conches etc. sounded there
There was terrible uproar of warrior

704.g: ਬਹੇ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਅਸਤ੍ਰੰ ਨਚੇ ਭੂਤ ਪ੍ਰੇਤੰ ॥੨੯੭॥
704.t: bahe sasatr asatra(n) nache bhoot preta(n) ||297||
704.e: The arms and weapons were struck and the ghosts and fiends danced.70.297.

704.g: ਫਰੀ ਧੋਪ ਪਾਇਕ ਸੁ ਖੰਡੇ ਬਿਸੇਖੰ ॥
704.t: faree dhop paik su kha(n)dde bisekha(n) ||

704.g: ਤੁਰੇ ਤੁੰਦ ਤਾਜੀ ਭਏ ਭੂਤ ਭੇਖੰ ॥
704.t: ture tu(n)dh taajee bhe bhoot bhekha(n) ||
704.e: Holding the sword, the prominent warriors were fragmented and the high-speed horses ran before the Vaitals in the battlefield

704.g: ਰਣੰ ਰਾਗ ਬਜੇ ਤਿ ਗਜੇ ਭਟਾਣੰ ॥
704.t: rana(n) raag baje ta gaje bhaTaana(n) ||
704.e: The war-horns were blown and the warriors thundered
The horses danced and the mighty warriors struck their blows while turning over.71.298.
The horses neighed and the bodies of the mighty warriors writhed

704.g: ਨਚੇ ਸੁਧ ਸਿਧੰ ਉਠੀ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਝਾਰੰ ॥੨੯੯॥
704.t: nache sudh sidha(n) uThee sasatr jhaara(n) ||299||
704.e: There was clattering of the arms and weapons and the adepts and Yogis, getting intoxicated began to dance with the tune of the weapons.72.299.
The dreadful goddesses Kali and Kamakhya shrieked violently and the worriors throwing fire-arms and the Vaitals and Vultures terribly shouts
The sixty-four Yoginis wearing rosaries saturated with blood enthusiastically threw the flames of Yoga.73.300.
The sharp knives were thrown in the field, which caused the galloping horses to become furious and the blood of the warriors oozed out and flowed
The horses to good races looked splendid and the Kandhari, Samundari and other types of horses also wandered.74.301.

704.g: ਤੁਰੇ ਤੁੰਦ ਤਾਜੀ ਉਠੇ ਕਛ ਅਛੰ ॥
704.t: ture tu(n)dh taajee uThe kachh achha(n) ||

704.e: The speedy horses of Kutch state were running and the horses of Arabia, while running looked like the mounts flying with wings

704.g: ਉਠੀ ਧੂਰਿ ਪੂਰੰ ਛੁਹੀ ਐਣ ਗੈਣੰ ॥
704.t: auThee dhoor poora(n) chhuhee aain gaina(n) ||

704.g: ਭਯੋ ਅੰਧ ਧੁੰਧੰ ਪਰੀ ਜਾਨੁ ਰੈਣੰ ॥੩੦੨॥
704.t: bhayo a(n)dh dhu(n)dha(n) paree jaan raina(n) ||302||
704.e: The dust which arose, covered the sky like this and there was so much mist that the night seemed to have fallen.75.302.
From one side, the followers of Dutt ran and from the second side other people

704.g: ਰਹੀ ਧੂਰਿ ਪੂਰੰ ਪਰੀ ਕਟਿ ਲੁਥੰ ॥
704.t: rahee dhoor poora(n) paree kaT lutha(n) ||
704.e: All atmosphere became dusty and the chopped corpses fell

704.g: ਚੜ੍ਯੋ ਚਉਪਿ ਕੈ ਤੁੰਦ ਨਚੇ ਤਤਾਰੀ ॥੩੦੩॥
704.t: chaRayo chaup kai tu(n)dh nache tataaree ||303||
704.e: The vows of the great vows-observing warriors broke and they enthusiastically mounted on the horses of Tattar and began to dance.76.303.

704.g: ਖੁਰੰ ਖੇਹ ਉਠੀ ਛਯੋ ਰਥ ਭਾਨੰ ॥
704.t: khura(n) kheh uThee chhayo rath bhaana(n) ||

704.g: ਦਿਸਾ ਬੇਦਿਸਾ ਭੂ ਨ ਦਿਖ੍ਰਯਾ ਸਮਾਨੰ ॥
704.t: dhisaa bedhisaa bhoo na dhikhrayaa samaana(n) ||
704.e: The dust from the hoofs of the horses covered the chariot of the sun and it deviated from its path and was not seen on the earth

704.g: ਛੁਟੇ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਅਸਤ੍ਰ ਪਰੀ ਭੀਰ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
704.t: chhuTe sasatr asatr paree bheer bhaaree ||

704.e: There was great stampede and the arms and weapons swords, shears, daggers etc. were struck.77.304.

705.g: ਭਜੀ ਸਰਬ ਸੈਣੰ ਨ ਨੈਣੰ ਨਿਹਾਰ੍ਯੋ ॥
705.t: bhajee sarab saina(n) na naina(n) nihaarayo ||
705.e: Holding his arrow, Dutt, discharged it on others and without seeing, the whole army ran away

705.g: ਜਿਨ੍ਰਯੋ ਬੀਰ ਏਕੈ ਅਨੇਕੰ ਪਰਾਨੋ ॥
705.t: jinrayo beer ekai aneka(n) paraano ||
705.e: Only one warriors conquered all and many warriors fled

705.g: ਪੁਰਾਨੇ ਪਲਾਸੀ ਹਨੇ ਪੌਨ ਮਾਨੋ ॥੩੦੫॥
705.t: puraane palaasee hane pauan maano ||305||
705.e: The feet of the warriors were uprooted like the uprooting of the old Palaash trees by the wind.78.305.

705.g: ਰਣੰ ਰੋਸ ਕੈ ਲੋਭ ਬਾਜੀ ਮਟਕ੍ਰਯੋ ॥
705.t: rana(n) ros kai lobh baajee maTakrayo ||
705.e: Getting enraged in the war, Lobh (greed) caused his horse to run

705.g: ਭਜ੍ਯੋ ਬੀਰ ਬਾਚ੍ਯੋ ਅਰ੍ਰਯੋ ਸੁ ਝਟਕ੍ਯੋ ॥
705.t: bhajayo beer baachayo arrayo su jhaTakayo ||
705.e: Whosoever ran away from him, was saved, he stood there, was killed with a jerk

705.g: ਫਿਰ੍ਯੋ ਦੇਖ ਬੀਰੰ ਅਨਾਲੋਭ ਧਾਯੋ ॥
705.t: firayo dhekh beera(n) anaalobh dhaayo ||

705.g: ਛੁਟੇ ਬਾਣ ਐਸੇ ਸਬੈ ਬ੍ਯੋਮ ਛਾਯੋ ॥੩੦੬॥
705.t: chhuTe baan aaise sabai bayom chhaayo ||306||
705.e: The warrior named Alobh (non-greed), seeing him, returned and Lobha discharged so many arrows, which spread over the sky.79.306.

705.g: ਦਸੰ ਬਾਣ ਲੈ ਬੀਰ ਧੀਰੰ ਪ੍ਰਹਾਰੇ ॥
705.t: dhasa(n) baan lai beer dheera(n) prahaare ||

705.g: ਸਰੰ ਸਠਿ ਲੈ ਸੰਜਮੈ ਤਾਕਿ ਮਾਰੇ ॥
705.t: sara(n) saTh lai sa(n)jamai taak maare ||
705.e: He attacked with ten arrows on the warrior named Dhairya (patience) and he discharged sixty arrows on, making Sanjam (restraint) as his target

705.g: ਨਵੰ ਬਾਣ ਸੋ ਨੇਮ ਕੋ ਅੰਗ ਛੇਦ੍ਯੋ ॥
705.t: nava(n) baan so nem ko a(n)g chhedhayo ||

705.g: ਬਲੀ ਬੀਸਿ ਬਾਣਾਨਿ ਬਿਗ੍ਰਯਾਨ ਬੇਧ੍ਰਯੋ ॥੩੦੭॥
705.t: balee bees baanaan bigrayaan bedhrayo ||307||
705.e: He pierced the limbs of Nem (principle) with his nine arrows and with twenty arrows, he attacked the mighty warrior Vigyan (Science).80.307.

705.g: ਪਚਿਸ ਬਾਣ ਪਾਵਿਤ੍ਰਤਾ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਹਾਰੇ ॥
705.t: pachis baan paavitrataa ko prahaare ||

705.g: ਅਸੀਹ ਬਾਣ ਅਰਚਾਹਿ ਕੈ ਅੰਗਿ ਝਾਰੇ ॥
705.t: aseeh baan arachaeh kai a(n)g jhaare ||
705.e: He attacked Pavitarta with twenty-five arrows and Arcchana with eighty arrows, whose limbs were chopped by him

705.g: ਪਚਾਸੀ ਸਰੰ ਪੂਰਿ ਪੂਜਾਹਿ ਛੇਦ੍ਯੋ ॥
705.t: pachaasee sara(n) poor poojaeh chhedhayo ||

705.g: ਬਡੋ ਲਸਟਕਾ ਲੈ ਸਲਜਾਹਿ ਭੇਦ੍ਯੋ ॥੩੦੮॥
705.t: baddo lasaTakaa lai salajaeh bhedhayo ||308||
705.e: He destroyed the complete Pooja (worship) with eighty-five arrows he beat Lajja with his big staff.81.308.

705.g: ਬਿਆਸੀ ਬਲੀ ਬਾਣ ਬਿਦ੍ਰਯਾਹਿ ਮਾਰੇ ॥
705.t: biaasee balee baan bidhrayaeh maare ||

705.g: ਤਪਸ੍ਰਯਾਹਿ ਪੈ ਤਾਕਿ ਤੇਤੀਸ ਡਾਰੇ ॥
705.t: tapasrayaeh pai taak tetees ddaare ||
705.e: Eighty-two arrows were discharged on Vidya and thirty-three on Tapasya:

705.g: ਕਈ ਬਾਣ ਸੋਂ ਕੀਰਤਨੰ ਅੰਗ ਛੇਦ੍ਯੋ ॥
705.t: kiee baan so(n) keeratana(n) a(n)g chhedhayo ||
705.e: The limbs of Keerti were pierced with innumerable arrows

705.g: ਅਲੋਭਾਦਿ ਜੋਧਾ ਭਲੀ ਭਾਤਿ ਭੇਦ੍ਯੋ ॥੩੦੯॥
705.t: alobhaadh jodhaa bhalee bhaat bhedhayo ||309||
705.e: The warriors like Alobh etc. were dealt with nicely.82.309.

705.g: ਨ੍ਰਿਹੰਕਾਰ ਕੋ ਬਾਨ ਅਸੀਨ ਛੇਦ੍ਯੋ ॥
705.t: niraha(n)kaar ko baan aseen chhedhayo ||

705.g: ਭਲੇ ਪਰਮ ਤਤ੍ਵਾਦਿ ਕੋ ਬਛ ਭੇਦ੍ਯੋ ॥
705.t: bhale param tatavaiaadh ko bachh bhedhayo ||
705.e: He pierced Nir-Ahamkara with eighty arrows and also touched with his arms the waist of Pram-Tattva etc.

705.g: ਕਈ ਬਾਣ ਕਰੁਣਾਹਿ ਕੇ ਅੰਗਿ ਝਾਰੇ ॥
705.t: kiee baan karunaeh ke a(n)g jhaare ||

705.g: ਸਰੰ ਸਉਕ ਸਿਛਿਆ ਕੇ ਅੰਗਿ ਮਾਰੇ ॥੩੧੦॥
705.t: sara(n) sauk sichhiaa ke a(n)g maare ||310||
705.e: The limbs of Karuna were cast down with many arrows and nearly one hundred arrows were discharged on the limbs of Shiksha.83.310.

705.g: ਦੋਹਰਾ ॥
705.t: dhoharaa ||
705.e: DOHRA

705.g: ਦਾਨ ਆਨਿ ਪੁਜਿਯੋ ਤਬੈ ਗ੍ਯਾਨ ਬਾਨ ਲੈ ਹਾਥਿ ॥
705.t: dhaan aan pujiyo tabai gayaan baan lai haath ||

705.g: ਜੁਆਨ ਜਾਨਿ ਮਾਰ੍ਯੋ ਤਿਸੈ ਧ੍ਯਾਨ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਕੇ ਸਾਥ ॥੩੧੧॥
705.t: juaan jaan maarayo tisai dhayaan ma(n)tr ke saath ||311||
705.e: Then the warrior name Daan, taking the arrows of Gyan in his hand, performed worship and gave offerings, charming it with Dhyan, he discharged it on that Youngman.84.311.

705.g: ਭੁਜੰਗ ਪ੍ਰਯਾਤ ਛੰਦ ॥
705.t: bhuja(n)g prayaat chha(n)dh ||
705.e: BHUJANG PRAYAAT STANZA

705.g: ਰਣੰ ਉਛਲ੍ਯੋ ਦਾਨ ਜੋਧਾ ਮਹਾਨੰ ॥
705.t: rana(n) uchhalayo dhaan jodhaa mahaana(n) ||

705.g: ਸਭੈ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਬੇਤਾ ਅਤਿ ਅਸਤ੍ਰੰ ਨਿਧਾਨੰ ॥
705.t: sabhai sasatr betaa at asatra(n) nidhaana(n) ||
705.e: The warriors named Daan sprang up in the war-arena, who was the store of arms, weapons and garments

705.g: ਦਸੰ ਬਾਣ ਸੋ ਲੋਭ ਕੋ ਬਛਿ ਮਾਰ੍ਯੋ ॥
705.t: dhasa(n) baan so lobh ko bachh maarayo ||
705.e: Taking ten arrows, he discharged them on the waist-area of Lobh

705.g: ਸਰੰ ਸਪਤ ਸੋ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਕੋ ਦੇਹੁ ਤਾਰ੍ਯੋ ॥੩੧੨॥
705.t: sara(n) sapat so krodh ko dheh taarayo ||312||
705.e: He seemed to be swimming in the seven oceans of Krodha.85.312.

705.g: ਨਵੰ ਬਾਣ ਬੇਧ੍ਰਯੋ ਅਨੰਨ੍ਰਯਾਸ ਬੀਰੰ ॥
705.t: nava(n) baan bedhrayo ana(n)nrayaas beera(n) ||

705.g: ਤ੍ਰਿਯੋ ਤੀਰ ਭੇਦ੍ਯੋ ਅਨਾਬਰਤ ਧੀਰੰ ॥
705.t: tirayo teer bhedhayo anaabarat dheera(n) ||
705.e: With nine arrows, he pierced the warrior named Anyaaya (injustice) and the warriors named Avarai was pierced with three arrows

705.g: ਭਯੋ ਭੇਦਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੰ ਸਤੰਸੰਗਿ ਮਾਰੇ ॥
705.t: bhayo bhedh krodha(n) sata(n)sa(n)g maare ||
705.e: With seven arrows, he wounded the warrior named karodh (anger)

705.g: ਭਈ ਧੀਰ ਧਰਮੰ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨ ਤਾਰੇ ॥੩੧੩॥
705.t: bhiee dheer dharama(n) braham giaan taare ||313||
705.e: In this way Brahm-Gyan (Knowledge of God or Dharma) was patiently established.86.313.

705.g: ਕਈ ਬਾਣ ਕੁਲਹਤ੍ਰਤਾ ਕੋ ਚਲਾਏ ॥
705.t: kiee baan kulahatrataa ko chalaae ||

705.g: ਕਈ ਬਾਣ ਲੈ ਬੈਰ ਕੇ ਬੀਰ ਘਾਏ ॥
705.t: kiee baan lai bair ke beer ghaae ||
705.e: Several arrows discharged at Kalah, making him the target and with many arrows the warriors of Vair (enmity) were killed

705.g: ਕਿਤੇ ਘਾਇ ਆਲਸ ਕੈ ਅੰਗਿ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
705.t: kite ghai aalas kai a(n)g laage ||

705.g: ਸਬੈ ਨਰਕ ਤੇ ਆਦਿ ਲੈ ਬੀਰ ਭਾਗੇ ॥੩੧੪॥
705.t: sabai narak te aadh lai beer bhaage ||314||
705.e: Many arrows struck the limbs of Aalas (laziness) and all these warriors fled towards hell.87.314.

705.g: ਇਕੈ ਬਾਣ ਨਿਸੀਲ ਕੋ ਅੰਗ ਛੇਦ੍ਯੋ ॥
705.t: eikai baan niseel ko a(n)g chhedhayo ||

705.g: ਦੁਤੀ ਕੁਸਤਤਾ ਕੋ ਭਲੈ ਸੂਤ ਭੇਦ੍ਯੋ ॥
705.t: dhutee kusatataa ko bhalai soot bhedhayo ||
705.e: With one arrow the limb of Asheel was pierced and the second arrow was very nicely inflicted Kutisata

705.g: ਗੁਮਾਨਾਦਿ ਕੇ ਚਾਰ ਬਾਜੀ ਸੰਘਾਰੇ ॥
705.t: gumaanaadh ke chaar baajee sa(n)ghaare ||

705.g: ਅਨਰਥਾਦਿ ਕੇ ਬੀਰ ਬਾਕੇ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥੩੧੫॥
705.t: anarathaadh ke beer baake nivaare ||315||
705.e: The comely horses of Abhiman (ego) were killed and also destroyed the fighters of ANARTH etc.88.315.

705.g: ਪਿਪਾਸਾ ਛੁਧਾ ਆਲਸਾਦਿ ਪਰਾਨੇ ॥
705.t: pipaasaa chhudhaa aalasaadh paraane ||

705.g: ਭਜ੍ਯੋ ਲੋਭ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੀ ਹਠੀ ਦੇਵ ਜਾਨੇ ॥
705.t: bhajayo lobh krodhee haThee dhev jaane ||
705.e: Pipasa (thirst), Kshudha (hunger), Aalas (laziness) etc. ran away and knowing the enragement of Daviva (divinity), Lobh (greed) also ran away

705.g: ਤਪ੍ਯੋ ਨੇਮ ਨਾਮਾ ਅਨੇਮੰ ਪ੍ਰਣਾਸੀ ॥
705.t: tapayo nem naamaa anema(n) pranaasee ||

705.g: ਧਰੇ ਜੋਗ ਅਸਤ੍ਰੰ ਅਲੋਭੀ ਉਦਾਸੀ ॥੩੧੬॥
705.t: dhare jog asatra(n) alobhee udhaasee ||316||
705.e: The destroyer of Aniyam (indiscipline), Niyam (principle) also became enraged and that detached one without greed assumed Yogastras (the arms of Yoga).89.316.

705.g: ਹਤ੍ਰਯੋ ਕਾਪਟੰ ਖਾਪਟੰ ਸੋਕ ਪਾਲੰ ॥
705.t: hatrayo kaapaTa(n) khaapaTa(n) sok paala(n) ||

706.g: ਹਨ੍ਯੋ ਰੋਹ ਮੋਹੰ ਸਕਾਮੰ ਕਰਾਲੰ ॥
706.t: hanayo roh moha(n) sakaama(n) karaala(n) ||
706.e: The head of Kapat (deception) was broken and he was killed and the dreadful warriors like Rosh (anger), Moha (attachments), Kaam (lust) etc. were also killed in great fury,

706.g: ਮਹਾ ਕ੍ਰੁਧ ਕੈ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਕੋ ਬਾਨ ਮਾਰ੍ਯੋ ॥
706.t: mahaa krudh kai krodh ko baan maarayo ||

706.g: ਖਿਸ੍ਰਯੋ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਦੋਖਾਦਿ ਸਰਬੰ ਪ੍ਰਹਾਰ੍ਯੋ ॥੩੧੭॥
706.t: khisrayo braham dhokhaadh saraba(n) prahaarayo ||317||
706.e: He shot and arrow on Karodh (anger) and in this way, the Lord in anger destroyed all the sufferings.90.317.

706.g: ਰੂਆਲ ਛੰਦ ॥
706.t: rooaal chha(n)dh ||
706.e: ROOAAL STANZA

706.g: ਸੁ ਦ੍ਰੋਹ ਅਉ ਹੰਕਾਰ ਕੋ ਹਜਾਰ ਬਾਨ ਸੋ ਹਨ੍ਯੋ ॥
706.t: s dhroh aau ha(n)kaar ko hajaar baan so hanayo ||
706.e: Droha (malice) and Ahamkara (ego) were also killed with a thousand arrows

706.g: ਦਰਿਦ੍ਰ ਅਸੰਕ ਮੋਹ ਕੋ ਨ ਚਿਤ ਮੈ ਕਛ ਗਨ੍ਯੋ ॥
706.t: dharidhr asa(n)k moh ko na chit mai kachh ganayo ||
706.e: No attention was paid, not even slightly, to Daridarta (lethargy) and Moha (attachment)

706.g: ਅਸੋਚ ਅਉ ਕੁਮੰਤ੍ਰਤਾ ਅਨੇਕ ਬਾਨ ਸੋ ਹਤ੍ਰਯੋ ॥
706.t: asoch aau kuma(n)trataa anek baan so hatrayo ||
706.e: Ashoch (impurity) and Kumantarna (bad counsel) were destroyed with many arrows and

706.g: ਕਲੰਕ ਕੌ ਨਿਸੰਕ ਹ੍ਵੈ ਸਹੰਸ੍ਰ ਸਾਇਕੰ ਛਤ੍ਰਯੋ ॥੩੧੮॥
706.t: kala(n)k kau nisa(n)k havai saha(n)sr saika(n) chhatrayo ||318||
706.e: Kalank (blemish) was fearlessly pierced with thousand of arrows.91.318.

706.g: ਕ੍ਰਿਤਘਨਤਾ ਬਿਸ੍ਵਾਸਘਾਤ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਘਾਤ ਮਾਰ੍ਯੋ ॥
706.t: kirataghanataa bisavaiaasaghaat mitraghaat maarayo ||
706.e: Kritghanta (ungratefulness), Vishwasghaat (breach of trust) and Mittraghaat (unfriendliness) were also killed

706.g: ਸੁ ਰਾਜ ਦੋਖ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਦੋਖ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਅਸਤ੍ਰ ਝਾਰ੍ਯੋ ॥
706.t: s raaj dhokh braham dhokh braham asatr jhaarayo ||
706.e: Brahmdosh and Raajdosh were finished with Bramastra (the arm of Brahman)

706.g: ਉਚਾਟ ਮਾਰਣਾਦਿ ਬਸਿਕਰਣ ਕੋ ਸਰੰ ਹਨ੍ਯੋ ॥
706.t: auchaaT maaranaadh basikaran ko sara(n) hanayo ||
706.e: Ucchatan, Maaran and Vashikarn etc. were killed with arrows

706.g: ਬਿਖਾਧ ਕੋ ਬਿਖਾਧ ਕੈ ਨ ਬ੍ਰਿਧ ਤਾਹਿ ਕੋ ਗਨ੍ਯੋ ॥੩੧੯॥
706.t: bikhaadh ko bikhaadh kai na biradh taeh ko ganayo ||319||
706.e: Vishaad (hatred), though considered old one, ws not let off.92.319.

706.g: ਭਜੇ ਰਥੀ ਹਈ ਗਜੀ ਸੁ ਪਤਿ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਧਾਰਿ ਕੈ ॥
706.t: bhaje rathee hiee gajee su pat traas dhaar kai ||
706.e: The charioteer, horses and the masters of elephants ran away in fear

706.g: ਭਜੇ ਰਥੀ ਮਹਾਰਥੀ ਸੁ ਲਾਜ ਕੋ ਬਿਸਾਰਿ ਕੈ ॥
706.t: bhaje rathee mahaarathee su laaj ko bisaar kai ||
706.e: Her great chariot-owners, forsaking their shame, fled away

706.g: ਅਸੰਭ ਜੁਧ ਜੋ ਭਯੋ ਸੁ ਕੈਸ ਕੇ ਬਤਾਈਐ ॥
706.t: asa(n)bh judh jo bhayo su kais ke bataieeaai ||
706.e: How should I describe this impossible and dreadful war as to how it was fought ?

706.g: ਸਹੰਸ ਬਾਕ ਜੋ ਰਟੈ ਨ ਤਤ੍ਰ ਪਾਰ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੩੨੦॥
706.t: saha(n)s baak jo raTai na tatr paar paieeaai ||320||
706.e: If the same is described hundreds or thousands of times, even then the end of its greatness cannot be known.93.320.

706.g: ਕਲੰਕ ਬਿਭ੍ਰਮਾਦਿ ਅਉ ਕ੍ਰਿਤਘਨ ਤਾਹਿ ਕੌ ਹਨ੍ਯੋ ॥
706.t: kala(n)k bibhramaadh aau kirataghan taeh kau hanayo ||
706.e: Kalank, Vibharam and Kritghanta etc. were killed

706.g: ਬਿਖਾਦ ਬਿਪਦਾਦਿ ਕੋ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਚਿਤ ਮੈ ਗਨ੍ਯੋ ॥
706.t: bikhaadh bipadhaadh ko kachhoo na chit mai ganayo ||
706.e: No attention was paid, even slightly to VISHAD, VIPDA etc.

706.g: ਸੁ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਦੋਖ ਰਾਜਦੋਖ ਈਰਖਾਹਿ ਮਾਰਿ ਕੈ ॥
706.t: s mitradhokh raajadhokh ieerakhaeh maar kai ||
706.e: After killing Mittradosh, Raajdosh, Irsha etc.

706.g: ਉਚਾਟ ਅਉ ਬਿਖਾਧ ਕੋ ਦਯੋ ਰਣੰ ਨਿਕਾਰਿ ਕੈ ॥੩੨੧॥
706.t: auchaaT aau bikhaadh ko dhayo rana(n) nikaar kai ||321||
706.e: Ucchatan and Vishad were driven out of the battlefield.94.321

706.g: ਗਿਲਾਨਿ ਕੋਪ ਮਾਨ ਅਪ੍ਰਮਾਨ ਬਾਨ ਸੋ ਹਨ੍ਯੋ ॥
706.t: gilaan kop maan apramaan baan so hanayo ||
706.e: Galani (hatred) was pierced with many arrows

706.g: ਅਨਰਥ ਕੋ ਸਮਰਥ ਕੈ ਹਜਾਰ ਬਾਨ ਸੋ ਝਨ੍ਰਯੋ ॥
706.t: anarath ko samarath kai hajaar baan so jhanrayo ||
706.e: Anarth was pierced with a thousand arrows with full power

706.g: ਕੁਚਾਰ ਕੋ ਹਜਾਰ ਬਾਨ ਚਾਰ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਹਾਰ੍ਯੋ ॥
706.t: kuchaar ko hajaar baan chaar so prahaarayo ||
706.e: Kuchaal was attacked with thousand of fine arrows

706.g: ਕੁਕਸਟ ਅਉ ਕੁਕ੍ਰਿਆ ਕੌ ਭਜਾਇ ਤ੍ਰਾਸੁ ਡਾਰ੍ਯੋ ॥੩੨੨॥
706.t: kukasaT aau kukriaa kau bhajai traas ddaarayo ||322||
706.e: Kashat and Kutriya were caused to run away.95.322.

706.g: ਛਪਯ ਛੰਦ ॥
706.t: chhapay chha(n)dh ||
706.e: CHAPAI STANZA

706.g: ਅਤਪ ਬੀਰ ਕਉ ਤਾਕਿ ਬਾਨ ਸਤਰਿ ਮਾਰੇ ਤਪ ॥
706.t: atap beer kau taak baan satar maare tap ||
706.e: Tapasya inflicted seventy arrows on Atap

706.g: ਨਵੇ ਸਾਇਕਨਿ ਸੀਲ ਸਹਸ ਸਰ ਹਨੈ ਅਜਪ ਜਪ ॥
706.t: nave saikan seel sahas sar hanai ajap jap ||
706.e: Sheel was inflicted with ninety arrows  Jaap struck a thousand arrows to Ajap,

706.g: ਬੀਸ ਬਾਣ ਕੁਮਤਹਿ ਤੀਸ ਕੁਕਰਮਹਿ ਭੇਦ੍ਯੋ ॥
706.t: bees baan kumateh tees kukarameh bhedhayo ||
706.e: Kumat was pierced with twenty arrows and Kukaram with thirty arrows

706.g: ਦਸ ਸਾਇਕ ਦਾਰਿਦ੍ਰ ਕਾਮ ਕਈ ਬਾਣਨਿ ਛੇਦ੍ਯੋ ॥
706.t: dhas saik dhaaridhr kaam kiee baanan chhedhayo ||
706.e: Ten arrows were shot at Daridarta and Kaam was pierced with many arrows

706.g: ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਬਿਰੋਧ ਕੋ ਬਧ ਕੀਯੋ ਅਬਿਬੇਕਹਿ ਸਰ ਸੰਧਿ ਰਣਿ ॥
706.t: bahu bidh birodh ko badh keeyo abibekeh sar sa(n)dh ran ||
706.e: The warrior Avivek killed the warrior Virodh in the war-arena

706.g: ਰਣਿ ਰੋਹ ਕ੍ਰੋਹ ਕਰਵਾਰ ਗਹਿ ਇਮ ਸੰਜਮ ਬੁਲ੍ਯੋ ਬਯਣ ॥੩੨੩॥
706.t: ran roh kroh karavaar geh im sa(n)jam bulayo bayan ||323||
706.e: Sanjam said, while taking up sword in his hand and getting infuriated in the battlefield.96.323.

706.g: ਅਰੁਣ ਪਛਮਹਿ ਉਗ੍ਵੈ ਬਰੁਣੁ ਉਤਰ ਦਿਸ ਤਕੈ ॥
706.t: arun pachhameh ugavai barun utar dhis takai ||
706.e: Even if the sun rises in the West or the clouds begin to come from the North

706.g: ਮੇਰੁ ਪੰਖ ਕਰਿ ਉਡੈ ਸਰਬ ਸਾਇਰ ਜਲ ਸੁਕੈ ॥
706.t: mer pa(n)kh kar uddai sarab sair jal sukai ||
706.e: If the Meru mountain flies and all the water of the ocean is dried up

706.g: ਕੋਲ ਦਾੜ ਕੜਮੁੜੈ ਸਿਮਟਿ ਫਨੀਅਰ ਫਣ ਫਟੈ ॥
706.t: kol dhaaR kaRamuRai simaT faneear fan faTai ||
706.e: Even if the teeth of KAL are bent and the hood of Sheshnaga is overturned

706.g: ਉਲਟਿ ਜਾਨ੍ਰਹਵੀ ਬਹੈ ਸਤ ਹਰੀਚੰਦੇ ਹਟੈ ॥
706.t: aulaT jaanrahavee bahai sat hareecha(n)dhe haTai ||
706.e: Even if the Ganges flows contrarily and Harish Chandra may forsake the path of truth

706.g: ਸੰਸਾਰ ਉਲਟ ਪੁਲਟ ਹ੍ਵੈ ਧਸਕਿ ਧਉਲ ਧਰਣੀ ਫਟੈ ॥
706.t: sa(n)saar ulaT pulaT havai dhasak dhaul dharanee faTai ||

706.g: ਸੁਨਿ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਅਬਿਬੇਕ ਸੁ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਭਟਿ ਤਦਪਿ ਨ ਲਟਿ ਸੰਜਮ ਹਟੈ ॥੩੨੪॥
706.t: sun nirap abibek su bibek bhaT tadhap na laT sa(n)jam haTai ||324||
706.e: Even if the world is upturned and the earth stabilized on the back of the bull may burst while sinking, but O king Avivek, the heroic discipline of Vivek will not step back even then.97.324.

706.g: ਤੇਰੇ ਜੋਰਿ ਮੈ ਗੁੰਗਾ ਕਹਤਾ ਹੋ ॥
706.t: tere jor mai gu(n)gaa kahataa ho ||

706.g: ਤੇਰਾ ਸਦਕਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਿ ॥
706.t: teraa sadhakaa teree saran ||
706.e: I, a dumbed one, speak with your grace, I am a sacrifice to you and under your refuge.

706.g: ਭੁਜੰਗ ਪ੍ਰਯਾਤ ਛੰਦ ॥
706.t: bhuja(n)g prayaat chha(n)dh ||
706.e: BHUJANG PRAYAAT STANZA

706.g: ਕੁਪ੍ਰਯੋ ਸੰਜਮੰ ਪਰਮ ਜੋਧਾ ਜੁਝਾਰੰ ॥
706.t: kuprayo sa(n)jama(n) param jodhaa jujhaara(n) ||

706.g: ਬਡੋ ਗਰਬਧਾਰੀ ਬਡੋ ਨਿਰਬਿਕਾਰੰ ॥
706.t: baddo garabadhaaree baddo nirabikaara(n) ||
706.e: The great warrior Sanjam got infuriated  he was proud and vice-less

706.g: ਅਨੰਤਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਲੈ ਕੈ ਅਨਰਥੈ ਪ੍ਰਹਾਰ੍ਯੋ ॥
706.t: ana(n)taasatr lai kai anarathai prahaarayo ||

706.g: ਅਨਾਦਤ ਕੇ ਅੰਗ ਕੋ ਛੇਦ ਡਾਰ੍ਯੋ ॥੩੨੫॥
706.t: anaadhat ke a(n)g ko chhedh ddaarayo ||325||
706.e: Taking up his innumerable arms, he attacked Anarth and pierced the limbs of Anadat.98.325.

706.g: ਤੇਰੇ ਜੋਰਿ ਕਹਤ ਹੌ ॥
706.t: tere jor kahat hau ||
706.e: I SPEAK WITH YOUR POWER :

706.g: ਇਸੋ ਜੁਧੁ ਬੀਤ੍ਯੋ ਕਹਾ ਲੌ ਸੁਨਾਊ ॥
706.t: eiso judh beetayo kahaa lau sunaauoo ||
706.e: There was such a war to what extent I should described it ?

706.g: ਰਟੋ ਸਹੰਸ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਨ ਤਉ ਅੰਤ ਪਾਊ ॥
706.t: raTo saha(n)s jihavaa na tau a(n)t paauoo ||
706.e: If I speak with thousand of tongues, even then I cannot know the end

706.g: ਦਸੰ ਲਛ ਜੁਗ੍ਰਯੰ ਸੁ ਬਰਖੰ ਅਨੰਤੰ ॥
706.t: dhasa(n) lachh jugraya(n) su barakha(n) ana(n)ta(n) ||

707.e: The war continued for the years of ten lakh ages and innumerable warriors died.99.326.
I UTTER WITH YOUR POWER :

707.g: ਭਈ ਅੰਧ ਧੁੰਧੰ ਮਚ੍ਯੋ ਬੀਰ ਖੇਤੰ ॥
707.t: bhiee a(n)dh dhu(n)dha(n) machayo beer kheta(n) ||
707.e: There was blind and rash destruction in war
The sixty-four Yoginis and the fiends danced
The dreadful Kamakkhya like Kali danced and the Dakinis (Vampires) belched like flames.100.327.
Thy Power

707.g: ਮਚ੍ਯੋ ਜੋਰ ਜੁਧੰ ਹਟ੍ਰਯੋ ਨਾਹਿ ਕੋਊ ॥
707.t: machayo jor judha(n) haTrayo naeh kouoo ||
707.e: There was terrible war and no one retraced his steps
There were many great warriors and Sovereigns there

707.g: ਮਿਟੇ ਜੁਧ ਤੇ ਏ ਨ ਜੋਧਾ ਜੁਝਾਰੰ ॥੩੨੮॥
707.t: miTe judh te e na jodhaa jujhaara(n) ||328||
707.e: This war continued in all the worlds and then warriors were not finished even in this dreadful war.101.328.
Thy Power
DOHRA

707.g: ਚਟਪਟ ਸੁਭਟ ਬਿਕਟ ਕਟੇ ਝਟਪਟ ਭਈ ਅਭੰਗ ॥
707.t: chaTapaT subhaT bikaT kaTe jhaTapaT bhiee abha(n)g ||
707.e: In that fierce fight the great warriors were chopped quickly

707.g: ਲਟਿ ਭਟ ਹਟੇ ਨ ਰਨ ਘਟ੍ਰਯੋ ਅਟਪਟ ਮਿਟ੍ਰਯੋ ਨ ਜੰਗ ॥੩੨੯॥
707.t: laT bhaT haTe na ran ghaTrayo aTapaT miTrayo na ja(n)g ||329||
707.e: No warrior ran and retraced his steps and this war did not end.102.329.
Thy Power
CHAUPAI

707.g: ਲਰੇ ਦੋਊ ਭਈ ਕਿਸ ਨ ਹਾਨਾ ॥
707.t: lare dhouoo bhiee kis na haanaa ||
707.e: The war continued from both sides for twenty lakh ages, but no one was defeated
Then the king got agitated and came to Matsyendra.103.330.

707.g: ਕਹਿ ਮੁਨਿ ਬਰਿ ਸਭ ਮੋਹਿ ਬਿਚਾਰਾ ॥
707.t: keh mun bar sabh moh bichaaraa ||

707.e: (The king said), “O superb sage! instruct me  both of them are great warriors

707.g: ਇਨ ਕਾ ਬਿਰੁਧ ਨਿਵਰਤ ਨ ਭਯਾ ॥
707.t: ein kaa birudh nivarat na bhayaa ||

707.e: Their opposition does not end and with the desire to get release from them, the whole world is going to end.104.331.

707.g: ਇਨ ਕਾ ਅੰਤ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਸੂਝਾ ॥
707.t: ein kaa a(n)t na kaahoo soojhaa ||
707.e: The whole world fought and fell on trying to kill them, but it could not know their end
These dreadful warriors are greatly persistent, greatly heroic and greatly terrible.105.332.
Hearing this Matsyendra remained silent and Parasnath etc. all of them said their things to him
There then occurred a miracle, marvelous for all and on the same day Charpatnath appeared.106.333.
Now begins the description of the Praise of Primal Purusha
CHAUPAI

707.g: ਇਨ ਕਹ ਦ੍ਵੈ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਏਕਾ ॥
707.t: ein keh dhavai jaanahu jin ekaa ||
707.e: “O king! listen, I speak to you a thing of knowledge
You should not consider both as one   these vice-less persons are great archers and brace fighters.107.334.
When Primal Purusha, the Lord reflected within Himself and visualized his own form himself, He uttered the world AUMKARA, because of which the earth, the sky and the whole world was created.108.335.
He created truth from the right side and
Made falsehood on the left
On taking birth both these warriors began to fight and

707.g: ਤਬ ਤੇ ਕਰਤ ਜਗਤ ਮੈ ਰਾਰਾ ॥੩੩੬॥
707.t: tab te karat jagat mai raaraa ||336||
707.e: Since that time, they are opposing each other in the world.109.336.

708.e: If the span of life is increased by a thousand years, if the thousands of tongues are obtained and if the reflection is made for thousands of years, even then, O Lord! the limits of your cannot be known.110.337.
The dumb speaks by Thy power :
Many sages like Vyas, Prashar, Shringi etc. have mentioned it
A Brahma of thousands of faces has been seen, but all of them could not know Thy limits.111.338.
Thy Power
DOHRA

708.g: ਸਿੰਧੁ ਸੁਭਟ ਸਾਵੰਤ ਸਭ ਮੁਨਿ ਗੰਧਰਬ ਮਹੰਤ ॥
708.t: si(n)dh subhaT saava(n)t sabh mun ga(n)dharab maha(n)t ||

708.g: ਕੋਟਿ ਕਲਪ ਕਲਪਾਤ ਭੇ ਲਹ੍ਯੋ ਨ ਤੇਰੋ ਅੰਤ ॥੩੩੯॥
708.t: koT kalap kalapaat bhe lahayo na tero a(n)t ||339||
708.e: The mighty ocean, many heroes, sages, Gandharvas, Mahants etc. have been feeling agitated since crores of alpas (ages), but all of them could not know Thy limits.112.339.
I speak by Thy Power :
BHUJANG PRAYAAT STANZA

708.g: ਸੁਨੋ ਚਿਤ ਦੈ ਕੈ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ਬਿਰੋਧੰ ॥
708.t: suno chit dhai kai na keejai birodha(n) ||
708.e: O lion-like king! whatever I am saying to you, listen to it attentively and do not oppose it

708.g: ਸੁ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਆਦ ਪੁਰਖੰ ਅਨਾਦੰ ਸਰੂਪੰ ॥
708.t: s sree aadh purakha(n) anaadha(n) saroopa(n) ||

708.e: That Primal Purusha Lord, is without beginning, unconquerable, without secret, uncombustible and without form.113.340.
He is without name and place  He is indestructible,
Without beginning, unconquerable, fearless and without hatred
He is infinite master of the universe and the most Ancient One
He is present, future and past.114.341.

708.g: ਜਿਤੇ ਸਰਬ ਜੋਗੀ ਜਟੀ ਜੰਤ੍ਰ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
708.t: jite sarab jogee jaTee ja(n)tr dhaaree ||

708.e: He has conquered in this world all the Yogis, the hermits with matted locks, performers of Yajnas, the water-dwellers and Nishachars etc

708.g: ਜਤੀ ਜੋਗ ਜੁਧੀ ਜਕੀ ਜ੍ਵਾਲ ਮਾਲੀ ॥
708.t: jatee jog judhee jakee javaiaal maalee ||

708.e: He has subjugated the celibates, Yogis warriors, wearers of fire-flames around their necks, the mighty ones and the sovereigns of mountains.115.342.
Thy Power

708.g: ਸਬੈ ਝੂਠੁ ਮਾਨੋ ਜਿਤੇ ਜੰਤ੍ਰ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੰ ॥
708.t: sabai jhooTh maano jite ja(n)tr ma(n)tra(n) ||
708.e: Consider all Yantras and Mantras as false and consider all those religions as hollow,

708.g: ਸਬੈ ਫੋਕਟੰ ਧਰਮ ਹੈ ਭਰਮ ਤੰਤ੍ਰੰ ॥
708.t: sabai fokaTa(n) dharam hai bharam ta(n)tra(n) ||
708.e: Which are deluded by the learning of Tantras

708.g: ਬਿਨਾ ਏਕ ਆਸੰ ਨਿਰਾਸੰ ਸਬੈ ਹੈ ॥
708.t: binaa ek aasa(n) niraasa(n) sabai hai ||
708.e: Without having hopes on that one Lord, you will be disappointed from all other sides

708.g: ਬਿਨਾ ਏਕ ਨਾਮ ਨ ਕਾਮੰ ਕਬੈ ਹੈ ॥੩੪੩॥
708.t: binaa ek naam na kaama(n) kabai hai ||343||
708.e: Without the one Name of the Lord, nothing else will be of any use.116.343.

708.g: ਕਰੇ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਜੰਤ੍ਰੰ ਜੁ ਪੈ ਸਿਧ ਹੋਈ ॥
708.t: kare ma(n)tr ja(n)tra(n) ju pai sidh hoiee ||

708.g: ਦਰੰ ਦ੍ਵਾਰ ਭਿਛ੍ਰਯਾ ਭ੍ਰਮੈ ਨਾਹਿ ਕੋਈ ॥
708.t: dhara(n) dhavaiaar bhichhrayaa bhramai naeh koiee ||
708.e: If the powers are realized through Mantras and Yantras, then no one will wander from door to door

708.g: ਬਿਨਾ ਏਕ ਕਰਮੰ ਸਬੈ ਭਰਮ ਜਾਨੈ ॥੩੪੪॥
708.t: binaa ek karama(n) sabai bharam jaanai ||344||
708.e: Remove your attention from all other sides, assuming only one hope in the mind and without the one action of the meditation on the Lord, consider all else as illusion.117.344.

708.g: ਭ੍ਰਮਿਯੋ ਭੀਤ ਚਿਤੰ ਕੁਪ੍ਰਯੋ ਜੇਮ ਪਾਨੰ ॥
708.t: bhramiyo bheet chita(n) kuprayo jem paana(n) ||
708.e: When the king heard these words of the Yogi, he became fearful in his mind like the oscillation of water
He forsook all the hopes and despairs from his mind and uttered these words to that great Yogi.118.345.
Thy Power
RASAAVAL STANZA
O great sage! you have been bestowed with all the powers
I request you to guide me.119.346.
The warriors of both the sides, persistent and enraged,

709.e: Ever remembering the Lord and destroyers of others uptil ocean 120.347.
They are the ones who resist, who fight persistently,
Who are severe and cruel and are the smashers of the enemies.121.348.
Thy Power
CHAUPAI

709.g: ਜੋ ਇਨ ਜੀਤਿ ਸਕੌ ਨਹਿ ਭਾਈ ॥
709.t: jo in jeet sakau neh bhaiee ||
709.e: If I cannot conquer them, I
Shall burn myself on the funeral pure

709.g: ਮੈ ਇਨ ਕਹਿ ਮੁਨਿ ਜੀਤਿ ਨ ਸਾਕਾ ॥
709.t: mai in keh mun jeet na saakaa ||
709.e: O sage! I could not conquer them

709.g: ਅਬ ਮੁਰ ਬਲ ਪੌਰਖ ਸਬ ਥਾਕਾ ॥੩੪੯॥
709.t: ab mur bal pauarakh sab thaakaa ||349||
709.e: My strength and courage have weakened.122.349.
Thinking in this way in his mind, the king apparently addressed all,
“I am a very great king and I have conquered the whole world.123.350.

709.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਮੋ ਕੋ ਇਹ ਬਾਤ ਬਤਾਈ ॥
709.t: jin mo ko ieh baat bataiee ||
709.e: “He who has told me to conquer both these warriors VIVEK and AVIVEK,
He has agitated me and driven my life to deception
Both of them are mighty warriors
The whole world is conquered, on conquering them.124.351.

709.g: ਅਬ ਮੋ ਤੇ ਏਈ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
709.t: ab mo te eiee jin jaiee ||

709.e: “Now they will not go away from me, O sage! describe them to me with clarity
“Now I prepare my own funeral pyre within your view, and sit within the fire-flames.”125.352.
After preparing the funeral pyre, he took bath and wore the garments of deep orange colour on his body

709.g: ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਲੋਗ ਹਟਕਿ ਕਰਿ ਰਹਾ ॥
709.t: bahu bidh log haTak kar rahaa ||

709.e: Many people forbade him and even fell at his feet.126.353.
Giving in charity various types of ornaments and garments, the king prepared a seat within the pyre
He burnt his body with various kinds of fires, but the flames became cold instead of burning him.127.354.
TOMAR STANZA
Getting infuriated, Parasnath burnt the fire in his hand,
which was dreadful in sight, but became cold there.128.355.
Then he got emerged the Yoga-fire, which was burning dreadfully
He killed himself with that fire and the people of the city continued to see that great king.129.356.
Then with many grass-blades, the faggots alongwith ghee (clarified butter),
The flames of fire arose, in which the king was burnt and his body was reduced to ashes.130.357.
That pyre continued to burn for several years, when the body of the king was reduced to ashes
And he abandoned the attachment of wealth and place.131.358.
SHABAD
The Lord is One the Victory is of the Lord.
The Lord is One the Victory is of the Lord.
RAMKALI OF THE TENTH KING
O mind! the asceticism be practised in this way :

709.g: ਬਨ ਸੇ ਸਦਨ ਸਬੈ ਕਰ ਸਮਝਹੁ ਮਨ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਉਦਾਸਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
709.t: ban se sadhan sabai kar samajhahu man hee maeh udhaasaa ||1|| rahaau ||
709.e: Consider your house as the forest and remain unattached within yourself…..Pause.

709.g: ਜਤ ਕੀ ਜਟਾ ਜੋਗ ਕੋ ਮੰਜਨੁ ਨੇਮ ਕੇ ਨਖਨ ਬਢਾਓ ॥
709.t: jat kee jaTaa jog ko ma(n)jan nem ke nakhan baddaao ||
709.e: Consider continence as the matted hair, Yoga as the ablution and daily observances as your nails,

709.g: ਗਿਆਨ ਗੁਰੂ ਆਤਮ ਉਪਦੇਸਹੁ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਭੂਤ ਲਗਾਓ ॥੧॥
709.t: giaan guroo aatam upadhesahu naam bibhoot lagaao ||1||
709.e: Consider the knowledge as the preceptor giving lessons to you and apply the Name of the Lord as ashes.1.

709.g: ਅਲਪ ਅਹਾਰ ਸੁਲਪ ਸੀ ਨਿੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਦਯਾ ਛਿਮਾ ਤਨ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
709.t: alap ahaar sulap see ni(n)dhraa dhayaa chhimaa tan preet ||
709.e: Eat less and sleep less, cherish mercy and forgiveness

709.g: ਸੀਲ ਸੰਤੋਖ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਰਬਾਹਿਬੋ ਹ੍ਵੈਬੋ ਤ੍ਰਿਗੁਣ ਅਤੀਤ ॥੨॥
709.t: seel sa(n)tokh sadhaa nirabaahibo havaibo tiragun ateet ||2||
709.e: Practise gentleness and contentment and remain free from three modes.2.

709.g: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਹੰਕਾਰ ਲੋਭ ਹਠ ਮੋਹ ਨ ਮਨ ਸਿਉ ਲ੍ਯਾਵੈ ॥
709.t: kaam krodh ha(n)kaar lobh haTh moh na man siau layaavai ||
709.e: Keep your mind unattached from lust, anger, greed, insistence and infatuation,

709.g: ਤਬ ਹੀ ਆਤਮ ਤਤ ਕੋ ਦਰਸੇ ਪਰਮ ਪੁਰਖ ਕਹ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੩॥੧॥
709.t: tab hee aatam tat ko dharase param purakh keh paavai ||3||1||
709.e: Then you will visualize the supreme essence and realise the supreme Purusha.3.1.
RAMKALI OF THE TENTH KING

709.g: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਜੋਗੁ ਕਮਾਓ ॥
709.t: re man ieh bidh jog kamaao ||
709.e: O Mind! the Yoga be practised in this way :

709.g: ਸਿੰਙੀ ਸਾਚੁ ਅਕਪਟ ਕੰਠਲਾ ਧਿਆਨ ਬਿਭੂਤ ਚੜਾਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
709.t: si(n)n(g)ee saach akapaT ka(n)Thalaa dhiaan bibhoot chaRaao ||1|| rahaau ||
709.e: Consider the Truth as the horn, sincerity the necklace and meditation as ashes to be applied to your body…...Pause.

709.g: ਤਾਤੀ ਗਹੁ ਆਤਮ ਬਸਿ ਕਰ ਕੀ ਭਿੱਛਾ ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰੰ ॥
709.t: taatee gahu aatam bas kar kee bhi'chhaa naam adhaara(n) ||
709.e: Make self-control your lyre and the prop of the Name as your alms,

709.g: ਬਾਜੇ ਪਰਮ ਤਾਰ ਤਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਉਪਜੈ ਰਾਗ ਰਸਾਰੰ ॥੧॥
709.t: baaje param taar tat har ko upajai raag rasaara(n) ||1||
709.e: Then the supreme essence will be played like the main string creating savoury divine music.1.

709.g: ਉਘਟੈ ਤਾਨ ਤਰੰਗ ਰੰਗਿ ਅਤਿ ਗਿਆਨ ਗੀਤ ਬੰਧਾਨੰ ॥
709.t: aughaTai taan tara(n)g ra(n)g at giaan geet ba(n)dhaana(n) ||
709.e: The wave of colourful tune will arise, manifesting the song of knowledge,

709.g: ਚਕਿ ਚਕਿ ਰਹੇ ਦੇਵ ਦਾਨਵ ਮੁਨਿ ਛਕਿ ਛਕਿ ਬ੍ਯੋਮ ਬਿਵਾਨੰ ॥੨॥
709.t: chak chak rahe dhev dhaanav mun chhak chhak bayom bivaana(n) ||2||
709.e: The gods, demons and sages would be amazed enjoying their ride in heavenly chariots.2.

709.g: ਆਤਮ ਉਪਦੇਸ ਭੇਸੁ ਸੰਜਮ ਕੋ ਜਾਪ ਸੁ ਅਜਪਾ ਜਾਪੈ ॥
709.t: aatam upadhes bhes sa(n)jam ko jaap su ajapaa jaapai ||
709.e: While instructing the self in the garb of self-restraint and reciting God’s Name inwardly,

709.g: ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਕੰਚਨ ਸੀ ਕਾਯਾ ਕਾਲ ਨ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਬ੍ਯਾਪੈ ॥੩॥੨॥
709.t: sadhaa rahai ka(n)chan see kaayaa kaal na kabahoo(n) bayaapai ||3||2||
709.e: The body will always remain like gold and become immortal.3.2.
RAMKALI OF THE TENTH KING
O Man! fall at the feet of the supreme Purusha,

709.g: ਸੋਵਤ ਕਹਾ ਮੋਹ ਨਿੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਮੈ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਸੁਚਿਤ ਹ੍ਵੈ ਜਾਗੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
709.t: sovat kahaa moh ni(n)dhraa mai kabahoo(n) suchit havai jaago ||1|| rahaau ||
709.e: Why are you sleeping in worldly attachment, awake sometimes and be vigilant ?.....Pause.

710.g: ਔਰਨ ਕਹਾ ਉਪਦੇਸਤ ਹੈ ਪਸੁ ਤੋਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਬੋਧ ਨ ਲਾਗੋ ॥
710.t: aauaran kahaa upadhesat hai pas toh prabodh na laago ||
710.e: O Animal! why do you preach to others, when you are quite ignorant

710.g: ਸਿੰਚਤ ਕਹਾ ਪਰੇ ਬਿਖਿਯਨ ਕਹ ਕਬਹੁ ਬਿਖੈ ਰਸ ਤ੍ਯਾਗੋ ॥੧॥
710.t: si(n)chat kahaa pare bikhiyan keh kabahu bikhai ras tayaago ||1||
710.e: Why are you gathering the sins ? Forsake sometimes the poisonous enjoyment.1.

710.g: ਕੇਵਲ ਕਰਮ ਭਰਮ ਸੇ ਚੀਨਹੁ ਧਰਮ ਕਰਮ ਅਨੁਰਾਗੋ ॥
710.t: keval karam bharam se cheenahu dharam karam anuraago ||
710.e: Consider these actions as illusions and devote yourself to righteous actions,

710.g: ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹ ਕਰੋ ਸਦਾ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਕੋ ਪਰਮ ਪਾਪ ਤਜਿ ਭਾਗੋ ॥੨॥
710.t: sa(n)greh karo sadhaa simaran ko param paap taj bhaago ||2||
710.e: Absorb yourself in the remembrance of the name of the Lord and abandon and run away from sins.2.

710.g: ਜਾ ਤੇ ਦੂਖ ਪਾਪ ਨਹਿ ਭੇਟੈ ਕਾਲ ਜਾਲ ਤੇ ਤਾਗੋ ॥
710.t: jaa te dhookh paap neh bheTai kaal jaal te taago ||
710.e: So that the sorrows and sins do not afflict you and you may escape the trap of death

710.g: ਜੌ ਸੁਖ ਚਾਹੋ ਸਦਾ ਸਭਨ ਕੌ ਤੌ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਰਸਿ ਪਾਗੋ ॥੩॥੩॥
710.t: jau sukh chaaho sadhaa sabhan kau tau har ke ras paago ||3||3||
710.e: If you want to enjoy all comforts, then absorb yourself in the love of the Lord.3.3.

710.g: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੋਰਠਿ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੀ ੧੦ ॥
710.t: raag soraTh paatisaahee 10 ||
710.e: RAGA SORATH OF THE TENTH KING

710.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੂ ਤੋ ਕਹ ਲਾਜ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥
710.t: prabh joo to keh laaj hamaaree ||
710.e: O Lord! You alone can protect my honour! O blue-throated Lord of men! O the Lord of forests wearing blue vests! Pause.

710.g: ਨੀਲ ਕੰਠ ਨਰਹਰਿ ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ਨੀਲ ਬਸਨ ਬਨਵਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
710.t: neel ka(n)Th narahar naarain neel basan banavaaree ||1|| rahaau ||
710.e: O Supreme Purusha! Supreme Ishwara! Master of all! Holiest Divinity! living on air

710.g: ਪਰਮ ਪੁਰਖ ਪਰਮੇਸਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪਾਵਨ ਪਉਨ ਅਹਾਰੀ ॥
710.t: param purakh paramesar suaamee paavan paun ahaaree ||
710.e: O the Lord of Lakshmi! the greatest Light! ,

710.g: ਮਾਧਵ ਮਹਾ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਧੁ ਮਰਦਨ ਮਾਨ ਮੁਕੰਦ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
710.t: maadhav mahaa jot madh maradhan maan muka(n)dh muraaree ||1||
710.e: The Destroyer of the demons Madhu and Mus! and the bestower of salvation!1.

710.g: ਨਿਰਬਿਕਾਰ ਨਿਰਜੁਰ ਨਿੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਿਰਬਿਖ ਨਰਕ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ॥
710.t: nirabikaar nirajur ni(n)dhraa bin nirabikh narak nivaaree ||
710.e: O the Lord without evil, without decay, without sleep, without poison and the Saviour from hell!

710.g: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਸਿੰਧ ਕਾਲ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਦਰਸੀ ਕੁਕ੍ਰਿਤ ਪ੍ਰਨਾਸਨਕਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
710.t: kirapaa si(n)dh kaal trai dharasee kukirat pranaasanakaaree ||2||
710.e: O the ocean of Mercy! the seer of all times! and the Destroyer of evil actions!....2.

710.g: ਧਨੁਰਪਾਨਿ ਧ੍ਰਿਤਮਾਨ ਧਰਾਧਰ ਅਨਬਿਕਾਰ ਅਸਿਧਾਰੀ ॥
710.t: dhanurapaan dhiratamaan dharaadhar anabikaar asidhaaree ||
710.e: O the wielder of bow! the Patient! the Prop of earth! the Lord without evil! and wielder of the sword!

710.g: ਹੌ ਮਤਿ ਮੰਦ ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨਾਗਤਿ ਕਰ ਗਹਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਉਬਾਰੀ ॥੩॥੧॥੪॥
710.t: hau mat ma(n)dh charan saranaagat kar geh leh ubaaree ||3||1||4||
710.e: I am unwise, I take refuge at Thy feet, catch hold of my hand and save me.3.

710.g: ਰਾਗੁ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੀ ੧੦ ॥
710.t: raag kaliaan paatisaahee 10 ||
710.e: RAGA KALYAN OF THE TENTH KING

710.g: ਬਿਨ ਕਰਤਾਰ ਨ ਕਿਰਤਮ ਮਾਨੋ ॥
710.t: bin karataar na kiratam maano ||
710.e: Do not accept anyone else except God as the Creator of the universe

710.g: ਆਦਿ ਅਜੋਨਿ ਅਜੈ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਤਿਹ ਪਰਮੇਸਰ ਜਾਨੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
710.t: aadh ajon ajai abinaasee teh paramesar jaano ||1|| rahaau ||
710.e: He, the Unborn, Unconquerable and Immortal, was in the beginning, consider Him as Supreme Ishvara……Pause.

710.g: ਕਹਾ ਭਯੋ ਜੋ ਆਨ ਜਗਤ ਮੈ ਦਸਕ ਅਸੁਰ ਹਰਿ ਘਾਏ ॥
710.t: kahaa bhayo jo aan jagat mai dhasak asur har ghaae ||
710.e: What then, if on coming into the world, one killed about ten demons

710.g: ਅਧਿਕ ਪ੍ਰਪੰਚ ਦਿਖਾਇ ਸਭਨ ਕਹ ਆਪਹਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਕਹਾਏ ॥੧॥
710.t: adhik prapa(n)ch dhikhai sabhan keh aapeh braham kahaae ||1||
710.e: And displayed several phenomena to all and caused others to call Him Brahm (God).1.

710.g: ਭੰਜਨ ਗੜ੍ਹਨ ਸਮਰਥ ਸਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋ ਕਿਮ ਜਾਤਿ ਗਿਨਾਯੋ ॥
710.t: bha(n)jan gaRhan samarath sadhaa prabh so kim jaat ginaayo ||
710.e: How can He be called God, the Destroyer, the Creator, the Almighty and Eternal,

710.g: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਸਰਬ ਕਾਲ ਕੇ ਅਸਿ ਕੋ ਘਾਇ ਬਚਾਇ ਨ ਆਯੋ ॥੨॥
710.t: taa te sarab kaal ke as ko ghai bachai na aayo ||2||
710.e: Who could not save himself from the wound-causing sword of mighty Death.2.

710.g: ਕੈਸੇ ਤੋਹਿ ਤਾਰਿਹੈ ਸੁਨਿ ਜੜ ਆਪ ਡੁਬਿਯੋ ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰ ॥
710.t: kaise toh taarihai sun jaR aap ddubiyo bhav saagar ||
710.e: O fool! listen, how can he cause you to cause the dreadful ocean of Sansara (world), when he himself is drowned in great ocean?

710.g: ਛੁਟਿਹੋ ਕਾਲ ਫਾਸ ਤੇ ਤਬ ਹੀ ਗਹੋ ਸਰਨਿ ਜਗਤਾਗਰ ॥੩॥੧॥੫॥
710.t: chhuTiho kaal faas te tab hee gaho saran jagataagar ||3||1||5||
710.e: You can escape the trap of death only when you catch hold of the prop of the world and take refuge in Him.3.

711.g: ਖਿਆਲ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੀ ੧੦ ॥
711.t: khiaal paatisaahee 10 ||
711.e: KHYAL OF THE TENTH KING

711.g: ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਨੂੰ ਹਾਲੁ ਮੁਰੀਦਾਂ ਦਾ ਕਹਣਾ ॥
711.t: mitr piaare noo(n) haal mureedhaa(n) dhaa kahanaa ||
711.e: Convey to the dear friend the condition of the disciples,

711.g: ਤੁਧ ਬਿਨੁ ਰੋਗੁ ਰਜਾਈਆਂ ਦਾ ਓਢਣੁ ਨਾਗ ਨਿਵਾਸਾਂ ਦੇ ਰਹਣਾ ॥
711.t: tudh bin rog rajaieeaa(n) dhaa oddan naag nivaasaa(n) dhe rahanaa ||
711.e: Without Thee, the taking over of quilt is like disease and living in the house is like living with serpents

711.g: ਸੂਲ ਸੁਰਾਹੀ ਖੰਜਰੁ ਪਿਯਾਲਾ ਬਿੰਗ ਕਸਾਈਯਾਂ ਦਾ ਸਹਣਾ ॥
711.t: sool suraahee kha(n)jar piyaalaa bi(n)g kasaieeyaa(n) dhaa sahanaa ||
711.e: The flask is like the spike, the cup is like a dagger and (the separation) is like enduring the chopper of the butchers,

711.g: ਯਾਰੜੇ ਦਾ ਸਾਨੂੰ ਸੱਥਰ ਚੰਗਾ ਭੱਠ ਖੇੜਿਆਂ ਦਾ ਰਹਣਾ ॥੧॥੧॥੬॥
711.t: yaaraRe dhaa saanoo(n) sa'thar cha(n)gaa bha'Th kheRiaa(n) dhaa rahanaa ||1||1||6||
711.e: The pallet of the beloved Friend is most pleasing and the worldly pleasures are like furnace.1.1

711.g: ਤਿਲੰਗ ਕਾਫੀ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੀ ੧੦ ॥
711.t: tila(n)g kaafee paatisaahee 10 ||
711.e: TILNG KAFI OF THE TENTH KING

711.g: ਕੇਵਲ ਕਾਲਈ ਕਰਤਾਰ ॥
711.t: keval kaaliee karataar ||
711.e: The supreme Destroyer is alone the Creator,

711.g: ਆਦਿ ਅੰਤ ਅਨੰਤ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਗੜ੍ਹਨ ਭੰਜਨਹਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
711.t: aadh a(n)t ana(n)t moorat gaRhan bha(n)janahaar ||1|| rahaau ||
711.e: He is in the beginning and in the end, He is the infinite entity, the Creator and the Destroyer…Pause.

711.g: ਨਿੰਦ ਉਸਤਤ ਜਉਨ ਕੇ ਸਮ ਸਤ੍ਰ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
711.t: ni(n)dh usatat jaun ke sam satr mitr na koi ||
711.e: The calumny and Praise are equal to him and he has no friend, no foe,

711.g: ਕਉਨ ਬਾਟ ਪਰੀ ਤਿਸੈ ਪਥ ਸਾਰਥੀ ਰਥ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
711.t: kaun baaT paree tisai path saarathee rath hoi ||1||
711.e: Of what crucial necessity, He became the charioteer ?1.

711.g: ਤਾਤ ਮਾਤ ਨ ਜਾਤ ਜਾਕਰ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਪੌਤ੍ਰ ਮੁਕੰਦ ॥
711.t: taat maat na jaat jaakar putr pauatr muka(n)dh ||
711.e: He, the Giver of salvation, has no father, no mother, no son and no grandson

711.g: ਕਉਨ ਕਾਜ ਕਹਾਹਿਂਗੇ ਤੇ ਆਨ ਦੇਵਿਕ ਨੰਦ ॥੨॥
711.t: kaun kaaj kahaahi(n)ge te aan dhevik na(n)dh ||2||
711.e: O what necessity he caused others to call Him the son of Devaki ?2.

711.g: ਦੇਵ ਦੈਤ ਦਿਸਾ ਵਿਸਾ ਜਿਹ ਕੀਨ ਸਰਬ ਪਸਾਰ ॥
711.t: dhev dhait dhisaa visaa jeh keen sarab pasaar ||
711.e: He, who has created gods, demons, directions and the whole expanse,

711.g: ਕਉਨ ਉਪਮਾ ਤੌਨ ਕੌ ਮੁਖ ਲੇਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਰਾਰ ॥੩॥੧॥੭॥
711.t: kaun upamaa tauan kau mukh let naam muraar ||3||1||7||
711.e: On what analogy should he be called Murar? 3.

711.g: ਰਾਗ ਬਿਲਾਵਲ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੀ ੧੦ ॥
711.t: raag bilaaval paatisaahee 10 ||
711.e: RAGA BILAWAL OF THE TENTH KING

711.g: ਸੋ ਕਿਮ ਮਾਨਸ ਰੂਪ ਕਹਾਏ ॥
711.t: so kim maanas roop kahaae ||
711.e: How can He be said to come in human form?

711.g: ਸਿਧ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਸਾਧ ਕਰ ਹਾਰੇ ਕ੍ਯੋਹੂੰ ਨ ਦੇਖਨ ਪਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
711.t: sidh samaadh saadh kar haare kayohoo(n) na dhekhan paae ||1|| rahaau ||
711.e: The Siddha (adept) in deep meditation became tired of the discipline on not seeing Him in any way…..Pause.

711.g: ਨਾਰਦ ਬਿਆਸ ਪਰਾਸਰ ਧ੍ਰੂਅ ਸੇ ਧਿਆਵਤ ਧਿਆਨ ਲਗਾਏ ॥
711.t: naaradh biaas paraasar dhraooa se dhiaavat dhiaan lagaae ||
711.e: Narad, Vyas, Prashar, Dhru, all meditated on Him,

711.g: ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਹਾਰਿ ਹਠ ਛਾਡਿਓ ਤਦਪਿ ਧਿਆਨ ਨ ਆਏ ॥੧॥
711.t: bedh puraan haar haTh chhaaddio tadhap dhiaan na aae ||1||
711.e: The Vedas and Puranas, became tired and forsook insistence, since He could not be visualized.1.

711.g: ਦਾਨਵ ਦੇਵ ਪਿਸਾਚ ਪ੍ਰੇਤ ਤੇ ਨੇਤਹ ਨੇਤ ਕਹਾਏ ॥
711.t: dhaanav dhev pisaach pret te neteh net kahaae ||
711.e: By demons, gods, ghosts, spirits, He was called indescribable,

711.g: ਸੂਛਮ ਤੇ ਸੂਛਮ ਕਰ ਚੀਨੇ ਬ੍ਰਿਧਨ ਬ੍ਰਿਧ ਬਤਾਏ ॥੨॥
711.t: soochham te soochham kar cheene biradhan biradh bataae ||2||
711.e: He was considered the finest of the fine and the biggest of the big.2.

712.g: ਭੂਮ ਅਕਾਸ ਪਤਾਲ ਸਭੈ ਸਜਿ ਏਕ ਅਨੇਕ ਸਦਾਏ ॥
712.t: bhoom akaas pataal sabhai saj ek anek sadhaae ||
712.e: He, the One, Created the earth, heaven and the nether-world and was called “Many”

712.g: ਸੋ ਨਰ ਕਾਲ ਫਾਸ ਤੇ ਬਾਚੇ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਿ ਸਿਧਾਏ ॥੩॥੧॥੮॥
712.t: so nar kaal faas te baache jo har saran sidhaae ||3||1||8||
712.e: That man is saved from the noose of death, who takes refuge in the Lord.3.

712.g: ਰਾਗ ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੀ ੧੦ ॥
712.t: raag dhevaga(n)dhaaree paatisaahee 10 ||
712.e: RAGA DEVGANDHARI OF THE TENTH KING

712.g: ਇਕ ਬਿਨ ਦੂਸਰ ਸੋ ਨ ਚਿਨਾਰ ॥
712.t: eik bin dhoosar so na chinaar ||
712.e: Do not recognize anyone except ONE

712.g: ਭੰਜਨ ਗੜਨ ਸਮਰਥ ਸਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਾਨਤ ਹੈ ਕਰਤਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
712.t: bha(n)jan gaRan samarath sadhaa prabh jaanat hai karataar ||1|| rahaau ||
712.e: He is always the Destroyer, the Creator and the Almighty  he the Creator is Omniscient…..Pause.

712.g: ਕਹਾ ਭਇਓ ਜੋ ਅਤ ਹਿਤ ਚਿਤ ਕਰ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧ ਸਿਲਾ ਪੁਜਾਈ ॥
712.t: kahaa bhio jo at hit chit kar bahu bidh silaa pujaiee ||
712.e: Of what use is the worship of the stones with devotion and sincerity in various ways?

712.g: ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਥਕਿਓ ਪਾਹਨ ਕਹ ਪਰਸਤ ਕਛੁ ਕਰਿ ਸਿਧ ਨ ਆਈ ॥੧॥
712.t: praan thakio paahan keh parasat kachh kar sidh na aaiee ||1||
712.e: The hand became tired of touching the stones, because no spiritual powr accrued.1.

712.g: ਅਛਤ ਧੂਪ ਦੀਪ ਅਰਪਤ ਹੈ ਪਾਹਨ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਖੈਹੈ ॥
712.t: achhat dhoop dheep arapat hai paahan kachhoo na khaihai ||
712.e: Rice, incense and lamps are offered, but the stones do not eat anything,

712.g: ਤਾ ਮੈਂ ਕਹਾਂ ਸਿਧ ਹੈ ਰੇ ਜੜ ਤੋਹਿ ਕਛੂ ਬਰ ਦੈਹੈ ॥੨॥
712.t: taa mai(n) kahaa(n) sidh hai re jaR toh kachhoo bar dhaihai ||2||
712.e: O fool! where is the spiritual power in them, so that they may bless you with some boon.2.

712.g: ਜੌ ਜੀਯ ਹੋਤ ਤੌ ਦੇਤ ਕਛੁ ਤੁਹਿ ਕਰ ਮਨ ਬਚ ਕਰਮ ਬਿਚਾਰ ॥
712.t: jau jeey hot tau dhet kachh tuh kar man bach karam bichaar ||
712.e: Ponder in mind, speech and action  if they had any life they could have given you something,

712.g: ਕੇਵਲ ਏਕ ਸਰਣ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਯੌ ਨਹਿ ਕਤਹਿ ਉਧਾਰ ॥੩॥੧॥੯॥
712.t: keval ek saran suaamee bin yau neh kateh udhaar ||3||1||9||
712.e: None can get salvation in any way without taking refuge in one Lord.3.1.

712.g: ਰਾਗ ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੀ ੧੦ ॥
712.t: raag dhevaga(n)dhaaree paatisaahee 10 ||
712.e: RAGA DEVGANDHARI OF THE TENTH KING

712.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਨ ਬਾਚਨ ਪੈਹੈ ॥
712.t: bin har naam na baachan paihai ||
712.e: None can be saved without the Name of the Lord,

712.g: ਚੌਦਹਿ ਲੋਕ ਜਾਹਿ ਬਸ ਕੀਨੇ ਤਾ ਤੇ ਕਹਾਂ ਪਲੈਹੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
712.t: chauadheh lok jaeh bas keene taa te kahaa(n) palaihai ||1|| rahaau ||
712.e: He, who control al the fourteen worlds, how can you run away from Him?...Pause.

712.g: ਰਾਮ ਰਹੀਮ ਉਬਾਰ ਨ ਸਕਹੈ ਜਾ ਕਰ ਨਾਮ ਰਟੈ ਹੈ ॥
712.t: raam raheem ubaar na sakahai jaa kar naam raTai hai ||
712.e: You cannot be save by repeating the Names of Ram and Rahim,

712.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨ ਰੁਦ੍ਰ ਸੂਰਜ ਸਸਿ ਤੇ ਬਸਿ ਕਾਲ ਸਬੈ ਹੈ ॥੧॥
712.t: brahamaa bisan rudhr sooraj sas te bas kaal sabai hai ||1||
712.e: Brahma, Vishnu Shiva, Sun and Moon, all are subject to the power of Death.1.

712.g: ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਕੁਰਾਨ ਸਬੈ ਮਤ ਜਾਕਹ ਨੇਤ ਕਹੈ ਹੈ ॥
712.t: bedh puraan kuraan sabai mat jaakeh net kahai hai ||
712.e: Vedas, Puranas and holy Quran and all religious system proclaim Him as indescribeable,2.

712.g: ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਫਨਿੰਦ੍ਰ ਮੁਨਿੰਦ੍ਰ ਕਲਪ ਬਹੁ ਧਿਆਵਤ ਧਿਆਨ ਨ ਐਹੈ ॥੨॥
712.t: ei(n)dhr fani(n)dhr muni(n)dhr kalap bahu dhiaavat dhiaan na aaihai ||2||
712.e: Indra, Sheshnaga and the Supreme sage meditated on Him for ages, but could not visualize Him.2.

712.g: ਜਾਕਰ ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗ ਨਹਿ ਜਨਿਯਤ ਸੋ ਕਿਮ ਸ੍ਯਾਮ ਕਹੈ ਹੈ ॥
712.t: jaakar roop ra(n)g neh janiyat so kim sayaam kahai hai ||
712.e: He, whose form and colour are not, how can he be called black?

712.g: ਛੁਟਹੋ ਕਾਲ ਜਾਲ ਤੇ ਤਬ ਹੀ ਤਾਂਹਿ ਚਰਨ ਲਪਟੈਹੈ ॥੩॥੧॥੧੦॥
712.t: chhuTaho kaal jaal te tab hee taa(n)h charan lapaTaihai ||3||1||10||
712.e: You can only be liberated from the noose of Death, when you cling to His feet.3.2.

712.g: ੴ ਵਾਹਿਗੁਰੂ ਜੀ ਕੀ ਫਤਹਿ ॥
712.t: ikOankaar vaahiguroo jee kee fateh ||
712.e: The Lord is One and the Victory is of the Lord.

712.g: ਸਵਯੇ ॥
712.t: savaye ||
712.e: THIRTY-THREE SWAYYAS

712.g: ਸ੍ਰੀ ਮੁਖਵਾਕ ਪਾਤਸਾਹੀ ੧੦ ॥
712.t: sree mukhavaak paatasaahee 10 ||
712.e: The utterance from the holy mouth of the Tenth King :

712.g: ਸਵੈਯਾ ॥
712.t: savaiyaa ||
712.e: SWAYYA

712.g: ਜਾਗਤ ਜੋਤਿ ਜਪੈ ਨਿਸ ਬਾਸੁਰ ਏਕੁ ਬਿਨਾ ਮਨਿ ਨੈਕ ਨ ਆਨੈ ॥
712.t: jaagat jot japai nis baasur ek binaa man naik na aanai ||
712.e: He is the true Khalsa (Sikh), who remembers the ever-awakened Light throughout night and day and does not bring anyone else into mind.

712.g: ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪ੍ਰਤੀਤ ਸਜੈ ਬ੍ਰਤ ਗੋਰ ਮੜ੍ਰਹੀ ਮਠ ਭੂਲ ਨ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
712.t: pooran prem prateet sajai brat gor maRrahee maTh bhool na maanai ||
712.e: The one who has complete faith in His unconditional love, shall never forget the path to Him.

712.g: ਤੀਰਥ ਦਾਨ ਦਇਆ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮ ਏਕੁ ਬਿਨਾ ਨਹਿ ਏਕ ਪਛਾਨੈ ॥
712.t: teerath dhaan dhiaa tap sa(n)jam ek binaa neh ek pachhaanai ||
712.e: Pilgrimages, charity, compassion, penance, and self-discipline—all are meaningless without realizing the One.

712.g: ਪੂਰਨ ਜੋਤਿ ਜਗੈ ਘਟ ਮੈ ਤਬ ਖਾਲਸ ਤਾਹਿ ਨ ਖਾਲਸ ਜਾਨੈ ॥੧॥
712.t: pooran jot jagai ghaT mai tab khaalas taeh na khaalas jaanai ||1||
712.e: When the perfect light illuminates within the heart, then only a true Khalsa (pure one) is recognized.

712.g: ਸਤਿ ਸਦੈਵ ਸਰੂਪ ਸਤ ਬ੍ਰਤ ਆਦਿ ਅਨਾਦਿ ਅਗਾਧ ਅਜੈ ਹੈ ॥
712.t: sat sadhaiv saroop sat brat aadh anaadh agaadh ajai hai ||
712.e: He is ever the Truth-incarnate, pledged to truth, the Eternal Primal One, Unfathomable and Unconquerable.

712.g: ਦਾਨ ਦਯਾ ਦਮ ਸੰਜਮ ਨੇਮ ਜਤ ਬ੍ਰਤ ਸੀਲ ਸੁਬ੍ਰਿਤ ਅਬੈ ਹੈ ॥
712.t: dhaan dhayaa dham sa(n)jam nem jat brat seel subirat abai hai ||
712.e: He is comprehended through His qualities of Charity, Mercifulness, Austerity, Restraint, Observances, Kindliness and Generosity.

712.g: ਆਦਿ ਅਨੀਲ ਅਨਾਦਿ ਅਨਾਹਦ ਆਪਿ ਅਦ੍ਵੇਖ ਅਭੇਖ ਅਭੈ ਹੈ ॥
712.t: aadh aneel anaadh anaahadh aap adhavaiekh abhekh abhai hai ||
712.e: He is Primal, Unblemished, Eternal, Unmalicious, Limitless, Indiscriminate and Fearless

712.g: ਰੂਪ ਅਰੂਪ ਅਰੇਖ ਜਰਾਰਦਨ ਦੀਨ ਦਯਾਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਭਏ ਹੈ ॥੨॥
712.t: roop aroop arekh jaraaradhan dheen dhayaal kirapaal bhe hai ||2||
712.e: He is the Formless, Unmarked, Lord Protector of the lowly and is ever compassionate.2.

712.g: ਆਦਿ ਅਦ੍ਵੈਖ ਅਵੇਖ ਮਹਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਤਿ ਸਰੂਪ ਸੁ ਜੋਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਸੀ ॥
712.t: aadh adhavaikh avekh mahaa prabh sat saroop su jot prakaasee ||
712.e: That great Lord is Primal, Unblemished, Sincere, Truth-incarnate and ever-effulgent Light

712.g: ਪੂਰ ਰਹਯੋ ਸਭ ਹੀ ਘਟ ਕੈ ਪਟ ਤਤ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਸੁਭਾਵ ਪ੍ਰਨਾਸੀ ॥
712.t: poor rahayo sabh hee ghaT kai paT tat samaadh subhaav pranaasee ||
712.e: The essence in Absolute Meditation is the Destroyer of all and Pervades in every heart.

712.g: ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਜਗਾਦਿ ਤੁਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਫੈਲ ਰਹਯੋ ਸਭ ਅੰਤਰ ਬਾਸੀ ॥
712.t: aadh jugaadh jagaadh tuhee prabh fail rahayo sabh a(n)tar baasee ||
712.e: O Lord! You are the Primal, from the beginning of the sages, pervading everywhere and in everyone.

712.g: ਦੀਨ ਦਯਾਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰ ਆਦਿ ਅਜੋਨ ਅਜੈ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥੩॥
712.t: dheen dhayaal kirapaal kirapaa kar aadh ajon ajai abinaasee ||3||
712.e: You are the Protector of the lowly, Merciful, Graceful, Primal, Unborn and Eternal.3.

712.g: ਆਦਿ ਅਭੇਖ ਅਛੇਦ ਸਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬੇਦ ਕਤੇਬਨਿ ਭੇਦੁ ਨ ਪਾਯੋ ॥
712.t: aadh abhekh achhedh sadhaa prabh bedh kateban bhedh na paayo ||
712.e: You art the Primal, Sincere, Invincible and Eternal Lord  the Vedas and the Semitic holy texts cannot know Your Mystery

712.g: ਦੀਨ ਦਯਾਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਨਿਧਿ ਸਤਿ ਸਦੈਵ ਸਭੈ ਘਟ ਛਾਯੋ ॥
712.t: dheen dhayaal kirapaal kirapaanidh sat sadhaiv sabhai ghaT chhaayo ||
712.e: O protector of the lowly, O compassionate and Treasure of Mercy Lord! You are Ever Truth and Pervader in all.

712.g: ਸੇਸ ਸੁਰੇਸ ਗਣੇਸ ਮਹੇਸੁਰ ਗਾਹਿ ਫਿਰੈ ਸ੍ਰੁਤਿ ਥਾਹ ਨਾ ਆਯੋ ॥
712.t: ses sures ganes mahesur gaeh firai srut thaeh naa aayo ||
712.e: Sheshnaga, Indra, Gandesha, Shiva and also the Shrutis (Vedas) could not know Your Mystery

712.g: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੂੜਿ ਅਗੂੜ ਇਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੈ ਕਿਹਿ ਕਾਜਿ ਕਹੋ ਬਿਸਰਾਯੋ ॥੪॥
712.t: re man mooR agooR iso prabh tai keh kaaj kaho bisaraayo ||4||
712.e: O my foolish mind! why have you forgotten such a Lord?4.

712.g: ਅਚੁਤ ਆਦਿ ਅਨੀਲ ਅਨਾਹਦ ਸਤ ਸਰੂਪ ਸਦੈਵ ਬਖਾਨੇ ॥
712.t: achut aadh aneel anaahadh sat saroop sadhaiv bakhaane ||
712.e: That Lord is described as Eternal, Eternal, Unblemished, Limitless, Invincible and Truth-incarnate.

712.g: ਆਦਿ ਅਜੋਨਿ ਅਜਾਇ ਜਹਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਰਮ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਪਰੰਪਰ ਮਾਨੇ ॥
712.t: aadh ajon ajai jahaa bin param puneet para(n)par maane ||
712.e: He is Powerful, Radiant, known throughout the world.

712.g: ਸਿਧ ਸਯੰਭੂ ਪ੍ਰਸਿਧ ਸਬੈ ਜਗ ਏਕ ਹੀ ਠੌਰ ਅਨੇਕ ਬਖਾਨੇ ॥
712.t: sidh saya(n)bhoo prasidh sabai jag ek hee Thauar anek bakhaane ||
712.e: His mention has been made in various ways at the same place.

712.g: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਰੰਕ ਕਲੰਕ ਬਿਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਤੈ ਕਿਹ ਕਾਰਣ ਤੇ ਨ ਪਹਿਚਾਨੇ ॥੫॥
712.t: re man ra(n)k kala(n)k binaa har tai keh kaaran te na pahichaane ||5||
712.e: O my poor mind! Why do you not recognize that Unblemished Lord?.5.

712.g: ਅਛਰ ਆਦਿ ਅਨੀਲ ਅਨਾਹਦ ਸਤ ਸਦੈਵ ਤੁਹੀ ਕਰਤਾਰਾ ॥
712.t: achhar aadh aneel anaahadh sat sadhaiv tuhee karataaraa ||
712.e: O Lord! You are Indestructible, Eternal, Limitless and forever Truth-incarnate and Creator

712.g: ਜੀਵ ਜਿਤੇ ਜਲ ਮੈ ਥਲ ਮੈ ਸਬ ਕੈ ਸਦ ਪੇਟ ਕੌ ਪੋਖਨ ਹਾਰਾ ॥
712.t: jeev jite jal mai thal mai sab kai sadh peT kau pokhan haaraa ||
712.e: You are the sustainer of all the beings living under and above the Earth's surface.

712.g: ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਕੁਰਾਨ ਦੁਹੂੰ ਮਿਲਿ ਭਾਤਿ ਅਨੇਕ ਬਿਚਾਰ ਬਿਚਾਰਾ ॥
712.t: bedh puraan kuraan dhuhoo(n) mil bhaat anek bichaar bichaaraa ||
712.e: The Vedas, Quran, Puranas together have mentioned many thoughts about you

712.g: ਔਰ ਜਹਾਨ ਨਿਦਾਨ ਕਛੂ ਨਹਿ ਏ ਸੁਬਹਾਨ ਤੁਹੀ ਸਿਰਦਾਰਾ ॥੬॥
712.t: aauar jahaan nidhaan kachhoo neh e subahaan tuhee siradhaaraa ||6||
712.e: But O Lord! there is none else like You in the whole universe. You are the supremely Chaste Lord of this universe.6.

712.g: ਆਦਿ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਅਛੇਦ ਅਭੇਦ ਅਲੇਖ ਅਜੇਅ ਅਨਾਹਦ ਜਾਨਾ ॥
712.t: aadh agaadh achhedh abhedh alekh ajea anaahadh jaanaa ||
712.e: Thou art considered Primal, Unfathomable, invincible, Indiscriminate, Accountless, Unconquerable and Limitless

712.g: ਭੂਤ ਭਵਿਖ ਭਵਾਨ ਤੁਹੀ ਸਬਹੂੰ ਸਬ ਠੌਰਨ ਮੋ ਮਨ ਮਾਨਾ ॥
712.t: bhoot bhavikh bhavaan tuhee sabahoo(n) sab Thauaran mo man maanaa ||
712.e: Thou art considered Pervasive in the present, past and future

712.g: ਸਦੇਵ ਅਦੇਵ ਮਣੀਧਰ ਨਾਰਦ ਸਾਰਦ ਸਤਿ ਸਦੈਵ ਪਛਾਨਾ ॥
712.t: sadhev adhev maneedhar naaradh saaradh sat sadhaiv pachhaanaa ||
712.e: The gods, demons, Nagas, Narada and Sharda have been ever thinking of Thee as Truth-incarnate

712.g: ਦੀਨ ਦਯਾਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਨਿਧਿਕੋ ਕਛੁ ਭੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਕੁਰਾਨ ਨ ਜਾਨਾ ॥੭॥
712.t: dheen dhayaal kirapaanidhiko kachh bhedh puraan kuraan na jaanaa ||7||
712.e: O protector of the lowly and the Treasure of Grace! Thy mystery could not be comprehended by the Quran and the Puranas.7.

712.g: ਸਤਿ ਸਦੈਵ ਸਰੂਪ ਸਦਾਬ੍ਰਤ ਬੇਦ ਕਤੇਬ ਤੁਹੀ ਉਪਜਾਯੋ ॥
712.t: sat sadhaiv saroop sadhaabrat bedh kateb tuhee upajaayo ||
712.e: O truth-incarnate Lord! Thou hast created the true modifications of Vedas and Katebs (semitic texts)

712.g: ਦੇਵ ਅਦੇਵਨ ਦੇਵ ਮਹੀਧਰ ਭੂਤ ਭਵਾਨ ਵਹੀ ਠਹਰਾਯੋ ॥
712.t: dhev adhevan dhev maheedhar bhoot bhavaan vahee Thaharaayo ||
712.e: At all times, the gods, demons and mountains, past and present have also considered Thee Truth-incarnate

712.g: ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਅਨੀਲ ਅਨਾਹਦ ਲੋਕ ਅਲੋਕ ਬਿਲੋਕ ਨ ਪਾਯੋ ॥
712.t: aadh jugaadh aneel anaahadh lok alok bilok na paayo ||
712.e: Thou art primal, from the beginning of the ages and limitless, who can be realized with profound insight in these worlds

712.g: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੂੜ ਅਗੂੜਿ ਇਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੋਹਿ ਕਹੋ ਕਿਹਿ ਆਨ ਸੁਨਾਯੋ ॥੮॥
712.t: re man mooR agooR iso prabh toh kaho keh aan sunaayo ||8||
712.e: O my mind! cannot say as to from which significant individual, I have heard the description of such a Lord.8.

712.g: ਦੇਵ ਅਦੇਵ ਮਹੀਧਰ ਨਾਗਨ ਸਿਧ ਪ੍ਰਸਿਧ ਬਡੋ ਤਪੁ ਕੀਨੋ ॥
712.t: dhev adhev maheedhar naagan sidh prasidh baddo tap keeno ||
712.e: The god, demons, mountains, Nagas and adepts practised sever austerities

712.g: ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਕੁਰਾਨ ਸਬੈ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ਥਕੇ ਪੈ ਤੋ ਜਾਇ ਨ ਚੀਨੋ ॥
712.t: bedh puraan kuraan sabai gun gai thake pai to jai na cheeno ||
712.e: The Vedas, the Puranas and the Quran, al were tired of singing His Praises, even then they could not recognize His mystery

712.g: ਭੂਮਿ ਅਕਾਸ ਪਤਾਰ ਦਿਸਾ ਬਿਦਿਸਾ ਜਿਹਿ ਸੋ ਸਬ ਕੇ ਚਿਤ ਚੀਨੋ ॥
712.t: bhoom akaas pataar dhisaa bidhisaa jeh so sab ke chit cheeno ||
712.e: The earth, sky, nether-world, dirctions and anti-directions are all pervaded by that Lord  the whole earth is filled with His Grandeur

712.g: ਪੂਰ ਰਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਮੋ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਮਨ ਮੈ ਤਿਨਿ ਆਨਿ ਮੁਝੈ ਕਹਿ ਦੀਨੋ ॥੯॥
712.t: poor rahee meh mo mahimaa man mai tin aan mujhai keh dheeno ||9||
712.e: And O mind  what new thing you have done for me by eulogizing Him?9.

712.g: ਬੇਦ ਕਤੇਬ ਨ ਭੇਦ ਲਹਯੋ ਤਿਹਿ ਸਿਧ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਸਬੈ ਕਰਿ ਹਾਰੇ ॥
712.t: bedh kateb na bhedh lahayo teh sidh samaadh sabai kar haare ||
712.e: The Vedas and Ketebs could not comprehend His Mystery and the adepts have been defeated in practising contemplation

712.g: ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਬੇਦ ਸਬੈ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਤਿ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਬੀਚਾਰ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
712.t: si(n)mirat saasatr bedh sabai bahu bhaat puraan beechaar beechaare ||
712.e: Various thought have been mentioned about God in Vedas, Shastras, Puranas and smrities

712.g: ਆਦਿ ਅਨਾਦਿ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਕਥਾ ਧ੍ਰੂਅ ਸੇ ਪ੍ਰਹਿਲਾਦਿ ਅਜਾਮਲ ਤਾਰੇ ॥
712.t: aadh anaadh agaadh kathaa dhraooa se prahilaadh ajaamal taare ||
712.e: The Lord-God is Primal, Beginningless and unfathomable

712.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਉਚਾਰ ਤਰੀ ਗਨਿਕਾ ਸੋਈ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰ ਬੀਚਾਰ ਹਮਾਰੇ ॥੧੦॥
712.t: naam uchaar taree ganikaa soiee naam adhaar beechaar hamaare ||10||
712.e: Stories are current about Him redeemed Dhruva, Prehlad and Ajamil  by remembering His name even Ganika was saved and the support of His name is also with us.10.

712.g: ਆਦਿ ਅਨਾਦਿ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਸਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਿਧ ਸ੍ਵਰੂਪ ਸਬੋ ਪਹਿਚਾਨਯੋ ॥
712.t: aadh anaadh agaadh sadhaa prabh sidh savairoop sabo pahichaanayo ||
712.e: All know that Lord as beginningless, unfathomable and adept-incarnate

712.g: ਗੰਧ੍ਰਬ ਜਛ ਮਹੀਧਰ ਨਾਗਨ ਭੂਮਿ ਅਕਾਸ ਚਹੂੰ ਚਕ ਜਾਨਯੋ ॥
712.t: ga(n)dhrab jachh maheedhar naagan bhoom akaas chahoo(n) chak jaanayo ||
712.e: The Gandharvas, Yakshas, men, Nagas consider him on the earth, sky and all the four directions

712.g: ਲੋਕ ਅਲੋਕ ਦਿਸਾ ਬਿਦਿਸਾ ਅਰੁ ਦੇਵ ਅਦੇਵ ਦੁਹੂੰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਾਨਯੋ ॥
712.t: lok alok dhisaa bidhisaa ar dhev adhev dhuhoo(n) prabh maanayo ||
712.e: All the world, directions, anti-directions, gods, demons all worship Him

712.g: ਚਿਤ ਅਗਯਾਨ ਸੁ ਜਾਨ ਸੁਯੰਭਵ ਕੌਨ ਕੀ ਕਾਨਿ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਭੁਲਾਨਯੋ ॥੧੧॥
712.t: chit agayaan su jaan suya(n)bhav kauan kee kaan nidhaan bhulaanayo ||11||
712.e: O ignorant mind! by following whom, you have forgotten that self-exstent omniscient Lord ? 11.

712.g: ਕਾਹੂੰ ਲੈ ਠੋਕਿ ਬਧੇ ਉਰਿ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕਾਹੂੰ ਮਹੇਸ ਕੋ ਏਸ ਬਖਾਨਯੋ ॥
712.t: kaahoo(n) lai Thok badhe ur Thaakur kaahoo(n) mahes ko es bakhaanayo ||
712.e: Someone has tied the stone-idol around his neck and someone has accepted Shiva as the Lord

712.g: ਕਾਹੂ ਕਹਿਯੋ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਕਾਹੂ ਮਸੀਤ ਕੈ ਬੀਚ ਪ੍ਰਮਾਨਯੋ ॥
712.t: kaahoo kahiyo har ma(n)dhar mai har kaahoo maseet kai beech pramaanayo ||
712.e: Someone considers the Lord within the temple or the mosque

712.g: ਕਾਹੂੰ ਨੇ ਰਾਮ ਕਹਯੋ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਕਹੁ ਕਾਹੂ ਮਨੈ ਅਵਤਾਰਨ ਮਾਨਯੋ ॥
712.t: kaahoo(n) ne raam kahayo kirasanaa kahu kaahoo manai avataaran maanayo ||
712.e: Someone calls him Ram or Krishna and someone believes in His incarnations,

712.g: ਫੋਕਟ ਧਰਮ ਬਿਸਾਰ ਸਬੈ ਕਰਤਾਰ ਹੀ ਕਉ ਕਰਤਾ ਜੀਅ ਜਾਨਯੋ ॥੧੨॥
712.t: fokaT dharam bisaar sabai karataar hee kau karataa jeea jaanayo ||12||
712.e: But my mind has forsaken all useless actions and has accepted only the One Creator.12.

712.g: ਜੌ ਕਹੋ ਰਾਮ ਅਜੋਨਿ ਅਜੈ ਅਤਿ ਕਾਹੇ ਕੌ ਕੌਸਲਿ ਕੁਖ ਜਯੋ ਜੂ ॥
712.t: jau kaho raam ajon ajai at kaahe kau kauasal kukh jayo joo ||
712.e: If we consider Ram, the Lord as Unborn, then how did he take brith from the womb of Kaushalya ?

712.g: ਕਾਲ ਹੂੰ ਕਾਲ ਕਹੋ ਜਿਹ ਕੌ ਕਿਹਿ ਕਾਰਣ ਕਾਲ ਤੇ ਦੀਨ ਭਯੋ ਜੂ ॥
712.t: kaal hoo(n) kaal kaho jeh kau keh kaaran kaal te dheen bhayo joo ||
712.e: He, who is said to be the KAL (destroyer) of KAL (death), then why did none become subjugated himself before KAL?

712.g: ਸਤਿ ਸਰੂਪ ਬਿਬੈਰ ਕਹਾਇ ਸੁ ਕਯੋਂ ਪਥ ਕੋ ਰਥ ਹਾਕਿ ਧਯੋ ਜੂ ॥
712.t: sat saroop bibair kahai su kayo(n) path ko rath haak dhayo joo ||
712.e: If he is called the Truth-incarnate, beyond enmity and opposition, then why did he become the charioteer of Arjuna ?

713.g: ਤਾਹੀ ਕੋ ਮਾਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਜਿਹ ਕੋ ਕੋਊ ਭੇਦੁ ਨ ਲੈਨ ਲਯੋ ਜੂ ॥੧੩॥
713.t: taahee ko maan prabhoo kar kai jeh ko kouoo bhedh na lain layo joo ||13||
713.e: O mind! you only consider him the Lord God, whose Mysetry could not be known to anyone.13.

713.g: ਕ੍ਯੋ ਕਹੋ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਨਿਧਿ ਹੈ ਕਿਹ ਕਾਜ ਤੇ ਬਧਕ ਬਾਣੁ ਲਗਾਯੋ ॥
713.t: kayo kaho kirasan kirapaanidh hai keh kaaj te badhak baan lagaayo ||
713.e: Krishna himself is considered the treasure of Grace, then why did the hunter shot his arrow at him ?

713.g: ਅਉਰ ਕੁਲੀਨ ਉਧਾਰਤ ਜੋ ਕਿਹ ਤੇ ਅਪਨੋ ਕੁਲਿ ਨਾਸੁ ਕਰਾਯੋ ॥
713.t: aaur kuleen udhaarat jo keh te apano kul naas karaayo ||
713.e: He has been described as redeeming the clans of others then he caused the destruction of his own clan

713.g: ਆਦਿ ਅਜੋਨਿ ਕਹਾਇ ਕਹੋ ਕਿਮ ਦੇਵਕਿ ਕੇ ਜਠਰੰਤਰ ਆਯੋ ॥
713.t: aadh ajon kahai kaho kim dhevak ke jaThara(n)tar aayo ||
713.e: He is said to be unborn and beginningless, then how did he come into the womb of Devaki ?

713.g: ਤਾਤ ਨ ਮਾਤ ਕਹੈ ਜਿਹ ਕੋ ਤਿਹ ਕਯੋ ਬਸੁਦੇਵਹਿ ਬਾਪੁ ਕਹਾਯੋ ॥੧੪॥
713.t: taat na maat kahai jeh ko teh kayo basudheveh baap kahaayo ||14||
713.e: He , who is considered without any father or mother, then why did he cause Vasudev to be called his father?14.

713.g: ਕਾਹੇ ਕੌ ਏਸ ਮਹੇਸਹਿ ਭਾਖਤ ਕਾਹਿ ਦਿਜੇਸ ਕੋ ਏਸ ਬਖਾਨਯੋ ॥
713.t: kaahe kau es maheseh bhaakhat kaeh dhijes ko es bakhaanayo ||
713.e: Why do you consider Shiva or Brahma as the Lord ?

713.g: ਹੈ ਨ ਰਘ੍ਵੇਸ ਜਦ੍ਵੇਸ ਰਮਾਪਤਿ ਤੈ ਜਿਨ ਕੋ ਬਿਸੁਨਾਥ ਪਛਾਨਯੋ ॥
713.t: hai na raghavaies jadhavaies ramaapat tai jin ko bisunaath pachhaanayo ||
713.e: There is none amongst Ram, Krishna and Vishnu, who may be considered as the Lord of the Universe by you

713.g: ਏਕ ਕੋ ਛਾਡਿ ਅਨੇਕ ਭਜੇ ਸੁਕਦੇਵ ਪਰਾਸਰ ਬਯਾਸ ਝੁਠਾਨਯੋ ॥
713.t: ek ko chhaadd anek bhaje sukadhev paraasar bayaas jhuThaanayo ||
713.e: Relinquishing the One Lord, you remember many gods and goddesses

713.g: ਫੋਕਟ ਧਰਮ ਸਜੇ ਸਬ ਹੀ ਹਮ ਏਕ ਹੀ ਕੌ ਬਿਧਿ ਨੇਕ ਪ੍ਰਮਾਨਯੋ ॥੧੫॥
713.t: fokaT dharam saje sab hee ham ek hee kau bidh nek pramaanayo ||15||
713.e: In this way you prove Shukdev, Prashar etc. as liars   all the so-called religions are hollow    I only accept the One Lord as the Providence.15.

713.g: ਕੋਊ ਦਿਜੇਸ ਕੁ ਮਾਨਤ ਹੈ ਅਰੁ ਕੋਊ ਮਹੇਸ ਕੋ ਏਸ ਬਤੈ ਹੈ ॥
713.t: kouoo dhijes k maanat hai ar kouoo mahes ko es batai hai ||
713.e: Someone tells Brahma as the Lord-God and someone tells the same thing about Shiva

713.g: ਕੋਊ ਕਹੈ ਬਿਸਨੋ ਬਿਸੁਨਾਇਕ ਜਾਹਿ ਭਜੇ ਅਘ ਓਘ ਕਟੈ ਹੈ ॥
713.t: kouoo kahai bisano bisunaik jaeh bhaje agh ogh kaTai hai ||
713.e: Someone considers Vishnu as the hero of the universe and says that only on remembering him, all the sins will be destroyed

713.g: ਬਾਰ ਹਜਾਰ ਬਿਚਾਰ ਅਰੇ ਜੜ ਅੰਤ ਸਮੇ ਸਬ ਹੀ ਤਜਿ ਜੈ ਹੈ ॥
713.t: baar hajaar bichaar are jaR a(n)t same sab hee taj jai hai ||
713.e: O fool! think about it a thousand times, all of them will leave you at the time of death,

713.g: ਤਾ ਹੀ ਕੋ ਧਯਾਨ ਪ੍ਰਮਾਨਿ ਹੀਏ ਜੋਊ ਕੇ ਅਬ ਹੈ ਅਰ ਆਗੈ ਊ ਹ੍ਵੈ ਹੈ ॥੧੬॥
713.t: taa hee ko dhayaan pramaan he'ee jouoo ke ab hai ar aagai uoo havai hai ||16||
713.e: Therefore, you should only meditate on Him, who is there in the present and who will also be there in future.16.

713.g: ਕੋਟਕ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਹ ਕੇ ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਉਪਿੰਦ੍ਰ ਬਨਾਇ ਖਪਾਯੋ ॥
713.t: koTak i(n)dhr kare jeh ke kiee koT upi(n)dhr banai khapaayo ||
713.e: He, who created crores of Indras and Upendras and then destroyed them

713.g: ਦਾਨਵ ਦੇਵ ਫਨਿੰਦ੍ਰ ਧਰਾਧਰ ਪਛ ਪਸੂ ਨਹਿ ਜਾਤਿ ਗਨਾਯੋ ॥
713.t: dhaanav dhev fani(n)dhr dharaadhar pachh pasoo neh jaat ganaayo ||
713.e: He, who created innumerable gods, demons, Sheshnaga, tortoises, birds, animals etc.,

713.g: ਆਜ ਲਗੇ ਤਪੁ ਸਾਧਤ ਹੈ ਸਿਵ ਊ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਕਛੁ ਪਾਰ ਨ ਪਾਯੋ ॥
713.t: aaj lage tap saadhat hai siv uoo brahamaa kachh paar na paayo ||
713.e: And for knowing whose Mystery, Shiva and Brahma are performing austerities even till today, but could not know His end

713.g: ਬੇਦ ਕਤੇਬ ਨ ਭੇਦ ਲਖਯੋ ਜਿਹ ਸੋਊ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰ ਮੋਹਿ ਬਤਾਯੋ ॥੧੭॥
713.t: bedh kateb na bhedh lakhayo jeh souoo guroo gur moh bataayo ||17||
713.e: He is such a Guru, whose Mystery could not be comprehended also by Vedas and Katebs and my Guru has told me the same thing.17.

713.g: ਧਯਾਨ ਲਗਾਇ ਠਗਿਓ ਸਬ ਲੋਗਨ ਸੀਸ ਜਟਾ ਨ ਹਾਥਿ ਬਢਾਏ ॥
713.t: dhayaan lagai Thagio sab logan sees jaTaa na haath baddaae ||
713.e: You are deceiving people by wearing matted locks on the head extending the nails in the hands in the hands and practicing false trance

713.g: ਲਾਇ ਬਿਭੂਤ ਫਿਰਯੋ ਮੁਖ ਊਪਰਿ ਦੇਵ ਅਦੇਵ ਸਬੈ ਡਹਕਾਏ ॥
713.t: lai bibhoot firayo mukh uoopar dhev adhev sabai ddahakaae ||
713.e: Smearing the ashes on your face, you are wandering, while deceiving all the gods and goddesses

713.g: ਲੋਭ ਕੇ ਲਾਗੇ ਫਿਰਯੋ ਘਰ ਹੀ ਘਰਿ ਜੋਗ ਕੇ ਨਯਾਸ ਸਬੈ ਬਿਸਰਾਏ ॥
713.t: lobh ke laage firayo ghar hee ghar jog ke nayaas sabai bisaraae ||
713.e: O Yogi! you are wandering under the impact of greed and you have forgotten all the discipline of Yoga

713.g: ਲਾਜ ਗਈ ਕਛੁ ਕਾਜੁ ਸਰਯੋ ਨਹਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਨਿ ਨ ਆਏ ॥੧੮॥
713.t: laaj giee kachh kaaj sarayo neh prem binaa prabh paan na aae ||18||
713.e: In this way your self—respect has been lost and no work could be accomplished  the Lord is not realized without true love.18.

713.g: ਕਾਹੇ ਕਉ ਡਿੰਭ ਕਰੈ ਮਨ ਮੂਰਖ ਡਿੰਭ ਕਰੇ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਪਤਿ ਖ੍ਵੈ ਹੈ ॥
713.t: kaahe kau ddi(n)bh karai man moorakh ddi(n)bh kare apunee pat khavai hai ||
713.e: O foolish mind! Why are you absorbed in hypocrisy?, because you will destroy your self-respect through hypocrisy

713.g: ਕਾਹੇ ਕਉ ਲੋਗ ਠਗੇ ਠਗ ਲੋਗਨਿ ਲੋਗ ਗਯੋ ਪਰਲੋਗ ਗਵੈ ਹੈ ॥
713.t: kaahe kau log Thage Thag logan log gayo paralog gavai hai ||
713.e: Why are you deceiving the people on becoming a cheat? And in this way you are losing the merit both in this and the next world

713.g: ਦੀਲ ਦਯਾਲ ਕੀ ਠੌਰ ਜਹਾ ਤਿਹਿ ਠੌਰ ਬਿਖੈ ਤੁਹਿ ਠੌਰ ਨ ਹ੍ਵੈ ਹੈ ॥
713.t: dheel dhayaal kee Thauar jahaa teh Thauar bikhai tuh Thauar na havai hai ||
713.e: You will not get a place, even very small one in the abode of the Lord

714.g: ਚੇਤ ਰੇ ਚੇਤ ਅਚੇਤ ਮਹਾ ਜੜ ਭੇਖ ਕੇ ਕੀਨੇ ਅਲੇਖ ਨ ਪੈ ਹੈ ॥੧੯॥
714.t: chet re chet achet mahaa jaR bhekh ke keene alekh na pai hai ||19||
714.e: Therefore O foolish creature! you away become careful even now, because by wearing a garb only, you will not be able to realise that Accountless Lord.19.

714.g: ਕਾਹੇ ਕਉ ਪੂਜਤ ਪਾਹਨ ਕਉ ਕਛੁ ਪਾਹਨ ਮੈ ਪਰਮੇਸਰ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
714.t: kaahe kau poojat paahan kau kachh paahan mai paramesar naahee ||
714.e: Why do you worship stones ?, because the Lord-God is not within those stones

714.g: ਤਾਹੀ ਕੋ ਪੂਜ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਕਰਿ ਕੇ ਜਿਹ ਪੂਜਤ ਹੀ ਅਘ ਓਘ ਮਿਟਾਹੀ ॥
714.t: taahee ko pooj prabhoo kar ke jeh poojat hee agh ogh miTaahee ||
714.e: You may only worship Him, whose adoration destroys clusters of sins

714.g: ਆਧਿ ਬਿਆਧਿ ਕੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਜੇਤਕ ਨਾਮ ਕੇ ਲੇਤ ਸਬੈ ਛੁਟਿ ਜਾਹੀ ॥
714.t: aadh biaadh ke ba(n)dhan jetak naam ke let sabai chhuT jaahee ||
714.e: With the remembrance on the Name of the Lord, the ties of all suffering are removed

714.g: ਤਾਹੀ ਕੋ ਧਯਾਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਮਾਨ ਸਦਾ ਇਨ ਫੋਕਟ ਧਰਮ ਕਰੇ ਫਲੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੨੦॥
714.t: taahee ko dhayaan pramaan sadhaa in fokaT dharam kare fal naahee ||20||
714.e: Ever mediate on that Lord because the hollow religious will not bear any fruit.20.

714.g: ਫੋਕਟ ਧਰਮ ਭਯੋ ਫਲ ਹੀਨ ਜੁ ਪੂਜ ਸਿਲਾ ਜੁਗਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਗਵਾਈ ॥
714.t: fokaT dharam bhayo fal heen ju pooj silaa jug koT gavaiee ||
714.e: The hollow religion became fruitless and O being! you have lost crores of years by worshipping the stones

714.g: ਸਿਧਿ ਕਹਾ ਸਿਲ ਕੇ ਪਰਸੈ ਬਲੁ ਬ੍ਰਿਧ ਘਟੀ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
714.t: sidh kahaa sil ke parasai bal biradh ghaTee nav nidh na paiee ||
714.e: You will not get power with the worship of stones  the strength and glory will only decrease

714.g: ਆਜ ਹੀ ਆਜੁ ਸਮੋ ਜੁ ਬਿਤਯੋ ਨਹਿ ਕਾਜਿ ਸਰਯੋ ਕਛੁ ਲਾਜਿ ਨ ਆਈ ॥
714.t: aaj hee aaj samo ju bitayo neh kaaj sarayo kachh laaj na aaiee ||
714.e: In this way, the time was lost uselessly and nothing was achieved and you were not ashamed

714.g: ਸ੍ਰੀ ਭਗਵੰਤ ਭਜਯੋ ਨ ਅਰੇ ਜੜ ਐਸੇ ਹੀ ਐਸੇ ਸੁ ਬੈਸ ਗਵਾਈ ॥੨੧॥
714.t: sree bhagava(n)t bhajayo na are jaR aaise hee aaise su bais gavaiee ||21||
714.e: O foolish intellect! you have not remembered the Lord and have wasted your life in vain.21.

714.g: ਜੌ ਜੁਗ ਤੇ ਕਰ ਹੈ ਤਪਸਾ ਕੁਛ ਤੋਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਸੰਨੁ ਨ ਪਾਹਨ ਕੈ ਹੈ ॥
714.t: jau jug te kar hai tapasaa kuchh toh prasa(n)n na paahan kai hai ||
714.e: You may even perform the austerities for an age, but these stones will not fulfil your wishes and please you

714.g: ਹਾਥਿ ਉਠਾਇ ਭਲੀ ਬਿਧਿ ਸੋ ਜੜ ਤੋਹਿ ਕਛੂ ਬਰਦਾਨੁ ਨ ਦੈ ਹੈ ॥
714.t: haath uThai bhalee bidh so jaR toh kachhoo baradhaan na dhai hai ||
714.e: They will not raise their hands and grant you the boon

714.g: ਕਉਨ ਭਰੋਸੋ ਭਯਾ ਇਹ ਕੋ ਕਹੁ ਭੀਰ ਪਰੀ ਨਹਿ ਆਨਿ ਬਚੈ ਹੈ ॥
714.t: kaun bharoso bhayaa ieh ko kahu bheer paree neh aan bachai hai ||
714.e: They can’t be trusted, because in the time of any difficulty, they will not reach and save you, therefore,

714.g: ਜਾਨੁ ਰੇ ਜਾਨੁ ਅਜਾਨ ਹਠੀ ਇਹ ਫੋਕਟ ਧਰਮ ਸੁ ਭਰਮ ਗਵੈ ਹੈ ॥੨੨॥
714.t: jaan re jaan ajaan haThee ieh fokaT dharam su bharam gavai hai ||22||
714.e: O ignorant and persistent being! ou may become careful, these hollow religious rituals will destroy your honour.22.

714.g: ਜਾਲ ਬਧੇ ਸਬ ਹੀ ਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕੇ ਕੋਊ ਰਾਮ ਰਸੂਲ ਨ ਬਾਚਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
714.t: jaal badhe sab hee mirat ke kouoo raam rasool na baachan paae ||
714.e: All the beings are entrapped in the nose of death and no Ram or Rasul (Prophet) could not escape form it

714.g: ਦਾਨਵ ਦੇਵ ਫਨਿੰਦ ਧਰਾਧਰ ਭੂਤ ਭਵਿਖ ਉਪਾਇ ਮਿਟਾਏ ॥
714.t: dhaanav dhev fani(n)dh dharaadhar bhoot bhavikh upai miTaae ||
714.e: That Lord created demos, gods and all other beings living on the earth and also destroyed them

714.g: ਅੰਤ ਮਰੇ ਪਛੁਤਾਇ ਪ੍ਰਿਥੀ ਪਰਿ ਜੇ ਜਗ ਮੈ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਕਹਾਏ ॥
714.t: a(n)t mare pachhutai pirathee par je jag mai avataar kahaae ||
714.e: Those who are known as incarnations in the world, they also ultimately repented and passed away

714.g: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਲੈਲ ਇਕੇਲ ਹੀ ਕਾਲ ਕੇ ਲਾਗਤ ਕਾਹਿ ਨ ਪਾਇਨ ਧਾਏ ॥੨੩॥
714.t: re man lail ikel hee kaal ke laagat kaeh na pain dhaae ||23||
714.e: Therefore, O my mind! why do you not run catch the feet of that Supreme KAL i.e. the Lord.23.

714.g: ਕਾਲ ਹੀ ਪਾਇ ਭਇਓ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਗਹਿ ਦੰਡ ਕਮੰਡਲ ਭੂਮਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਾਨਯੋ ॥
714.t: kaal hee pai bhio brahamaa geh dha(n)dd kama(n)ddal bhoom bhramaanayo ||
714.e: Brahma came into being under the control of KAL (death) and taking his staff and pot his hand, he wandered on the earth

714.g: ਕਾਲ ਹੀ ਪਾਇ ਸਦਾ ਸਿਵ ਜੂ ਸਭ ਦੇਸ ਬਦੇਸ ਭਇਆ ਹਮ ਜਾਨਯੋ ॥
714.t: kaal hee pai sadhaa siv joo sabh dhes badhes bhiaa ham jaanayo ||
714.e: Shiva was also under the control of KAL and wandered in various countries far and near
